-- Answer Key SQL: C1
-- Question: How many executives have been posted in the Delhi office for 5 years or more? Break down by grade and discipline.
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: aligned with H10/X10 rotation rule. Due = current continuous stay >= 60 months at
-- 2026-10-19 (v_continuous_stay), minus officers retiring within 3 x 365.25 days (JRTP 7.1 practice), minus officers
-- whose current posting carries a valid exemption tag (literal 'None' = no exemption; valid_until >= 2026-10-19 or NULL).

WITH cur_exempt AS (
    SELECT emp_id, LOGICAL_OR(
        LOWER(IFNULL(exemption_tag, 'none')) NOT IN ('none', '')
        AND (exemption_valid_until IS NULL OR exemption_valid_until >= DATE '2026-10-19')) AS has_valid_exemption
    FROM posting_history
    WHERE is_current_posting
    GROUP BY emp_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT v.grade_id, v.discipline_id, v.emp_id,
           DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 3 * 365.25 AS retiring_3yr,
           IFNULL(x.has_valid_exemption, FALSE) AS has_valid_exemption
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
    LEFT JOIN cur_exempt x ON x.emp_id = v.emp_id
    WHERE v.is_current_stay = TRUE
      AND v.wc_id = @wc_id
      AND v.grade_id LIKE 'E%'
      AND v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months
)
SELECT
    grade_id,
    discipline_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS delhi_executives_ge_5yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(retiring_3yr, emp_id, NULL)) AS exempt_retiring_3yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(NOT retiring_3yr AND has_valid_exemption, emp_id, NULL)) AS exempt_valid_tag,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(NOT retiring_3yr AND NOT has_valid_exemption, emp_id, NULL)) AS non_exempt_due_transfer
FROM base
GROUP BY grade_id, discipline_id
ORDER BY grade_id, discipline_id;

-- Answer Key SQL: C2
-- Question: Who is overdue for transfer under the rotation policy, and which hard or remote stations (NE, offshore) are short of people to receive them?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: previous SQL only counted in-position executives at four hand-picked NE work
-- centres (WC-ASM/JOR/TRI/SIL) - it identified neither who is overdue nor any shortfall. Now two sections:
--   section 'overdue_pool'      : executives overdue under JRTP Clause 3.2 (>= 60 months continuous stay at the
--                                 current work centre, hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay) excluding the Clause 7
--                                 3-year pre-retirement protection, by current work centre (top 10 sources);
--   section 'receiving_station' : hard/remote stations (hard_station_cat 'C', NE sector or offshore) with an
--                                 executive vacancy vs FY26 sanctioned posts (sanctioned_posts, E-grades).
-- company_overdue_total repeats the company-wide overdue count on every row for the headline.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20 (alignment with C1/H10/X10): overdue pool also excludes executives whose current
-- posting carries a valid exemption_tag ('None' = no tag; exemption_valid_until >= 2026-10-19 or NULL).

WITH overdue AS (
    SELECT v.wc_id, v.emp_id
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
    WHERE v.is_current_stay = TRUE
      AND v.grade_id LIKE 'E%'
      AND v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months
      AND DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) > 3 * 365.25
      AND v.emp_id NOT IN (
          SELECT ph.emp_id FROM posting_history ph
          WHERE ph.is_current_posting = TRUE
            AND NULLIF(ph.exemption_tag, 'None') IS NOT NULL
            AND (ph.exemption_valid_until >= DATE '2026-10-19' OR ph.exemption_valid_until IS NULL)
      )
),
od_wc AS (
    SELECT wc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS overdue_executives FROM overdue GROUP BY wc_id
),
sp AS (
    SELECT wc_id,
           SUM(sanctioned_strength) AS exec_sanctioned,
           SUM(in_position_strength) AS exec_in_position,
           SUM(vacancy_count) AS exec_vacancy
    FROM sanctioned_posts
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND grade_id LIKE 'E%'
    GROUP BY wc_id
),
tot AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS company_overdue_total FROM overdue),
pool AS (
    SELECT 'overdue_pool' AS section, w.wc_id, w.short_name, w.hard_station_cat, w.sector, w.onshore_offshore,
           o.overdue_executives, sp.exec_sanctioned, sp.exec_in_position, sp.exec_vacancy
    FROM od_wc o
    JOIN dim_work_centre w ON o.wc_id = w.wc_id
    LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.wc_id = o.wc_id
    ORDER BY o.overdue_executives DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
recv AS (
    SELECT 'receiving_station' AS section, w.wc_id, w.short_name, w.hard_station_cat, w.sector, w.onshore_offshore,
           COALESCE(o.overdue_executives, 0) AS overdue_executives, sp.exec_sanctioned, sp.exec_in_position, sp.exec_vacancy
    FROM sp
    JOIN dim_work_centre w ON sp.wc_id = w.wc_id
    LEFT JOIN od_wc o ON o.wc_id = sp.wc_id
    WHERE (w.hard_station_cat = 'C' OR LOWER(w.sector) = 'ne' OR LOWER(w.onshore_offshore) = 'offshore')
      AND sp.exec_vacancy > 0
)
SELECT u.*, tot.company_overdue_total,
       ROUND(u.exec_vacancy * 100.0 / NULLIF(u.exec_sanctioned, 0), 1) AS exec_vacancy_pct
FROM (SELECT * FROM pool UNION ALL SELECT * FROM recv) u
CROSS JOIN tot
ORDER BY u.section, CASE WHEN u.section = 'overdue_pool' THEN -u.overdue_executives ELSE -u.exec_vacancy END;

-- Answer Key SQL: C3
-- Question: Which areas saw no headcount increase in the last 5 years, and which saw the most?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (1) headcount_snapshot is a monthly stock - the old SQL SUMmed 12 FY26 months
-- against the single FY21 (March) snapshot, inflating growth ~10x (e.g. Eastern Offshore 960 -> 12,312,
-- +1,182%); (2) it hard-coded four work centres, so it could not say which areas saw no increase. Now: every
-- work centre, period-end snapshots 31-Mar-2021 (month '2021-03') vs 31-Mar-2026 (month '2026-03'), with a
-- flag for "no increase" (change <= 0). Ordered by absolute change, largest first.

WITH hc AS (
    SELECT
        wc_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2021-03' THEN headcount END) AS hc_mar21,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN headcount END) AS hc_mar26
    FROM headcount_snapshot
    WHERE month IN ('2021-03', '2026-03')
    GROUP BY wc_id
)
SELECT
    wc.wc_id,
    wc.short_name,
    wc.type AS wc_type,
    wc.sector,
    COALESCE(h.hc_mar21, 0) AS hc_mar21,
    COALESCE(h.hc_mar26, 0) AS hc_mar26,
    COALESCE(h.hc_mar26, 0) - COALESCE(h.hc_mar21, 0) AS hc_change,
    ROUND((COALESCE(h.hc_mar26, 0) - h.hc_mar21) * 100.0 / NULLIF(h.hc_mar21, 0), 1) AS growth_pct,
    (COALESCE(h.hc_mar26, 0) - COALESCE(h.hc_mar21, 0)) <= 0 AS no_increase
FROM hc h
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON h.wc_id = wc.wc_id
ORDER BY hc_change DESC, growth_pct DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C4
-- Question: How many E7+ (GM and above) officers retire in the next 3 years, and which of those roles have no ready successor?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (1) the retirement window was a DOB band 1966-04-01..1969-03-31 (= retirements
-- Apr-2026..Mar-2029, partly in the past) instead of the next 3 years from 2026-10-19; it found 39 retirees.
-- Now retirement_date BETWEEN 2026-10-19 AND 2029-10-18 on active staff; (2) E7+ now includes board-level
-- incumbents (DIR, CMD) as "GM and above"; (3) the old output only had grade x readiness counts and never named
-- a role. Two sections:
--   'grade_summary'           : per grade - active E7+, retiring in 3 years, of which in a succession-plan
--                               position, of which without any 'Ready_Now' successor, and not in any plan;
--   'role_no_ready_successor' : the succession-plan positions whose active incumbent retires within 3 years
--                               and where neither successor_1 nor successor_2 is 'Ready_Now'.

WITH e AS (
    SELECT emp_id, current_grade_id, current_wc_id, retirement_date
    FROM employee_master
    WHERE LOWER(employment_status) = 'active'
      AND current_grade_id IN ('E7', 'E8', 'E9', 'DIR', 'CMD')
),
j AS (
    SELECT e.*, sp.position_id, sp.role_title, sp.wc_id AS position_wc_id, sp.criticality_tier,
           sp.successor_1_readiness, sp.successor_2_readiness, sp.readiness_gap_reason,
           (sp.position_id IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(LOWER(sp.successor_1_readiness), '') != 'ready_now'
            AND COALESCE(LOWER(sp.successor_2_readiness), '') != 'ready_now') AS no_ready_successor,
           e.retirement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-19' AND DATE '2029-10-18' AS retires_3yr
    FROM e
    LEFT JOIN succession_plan sp ON sp.incumbent_emp_id = e.emp_id
)
SELECT
    'grade_summary' AS section,
    current_grade_id AS grade_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS role_title,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS work_centre,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS criticality_tier,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS retirement_date,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS successor_1_readiness,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS readiness_gap_reason,
    COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS active_officers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(retires_3yr, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_next_3yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(retires_3yr AND position_id IS NOT NULL, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_in_plan_position,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(retires_3yr AND no_ready_successor, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_no_ready_successor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(retires_3yr AND position_id IS NULL, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_not_in_succession_plan
FROM j
GROUP BY current_grade_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'role_no_ready_successor',
    j.current_grade_id,
    j.role_title,
    w.short_name,
    j.criticality_tier,
    j.retirement_date,
    j.successor_1_readiness,
    j.readiness_gap_reason,
    1, 1, 1, 1, 0
FROM j
JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = j.position_wc_id
WHERE j.retires_3yr AND j.no_ready_successor
ORDER BY section, grade_id, retirement_date;

-- Answer Key SQL: C5
-- Question: Which disciplines (geoscience, drilling, reservoir, production) face the biggest retirement-driven skill gap by 2030?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: counts were correct (retiring by 31-Mar-2030 = end of FY30) but the status filter
-- "employment_status = 'Active' OR separation_date IS NULL" is replaced by LOWER(employment_status) = 'active'
-- and the retirement test now uses retirement_date (same result, explicit). Added Geophysics (Wells) to the
-- geoscience set and an E0-E2 junior pipeline column so the "gap" can be read against replacement depth.

SELECT
    d.discipline_id,
    d.name AS discipline_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS active_executives,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.retirement_date <= DATE '2030-03-31' THEN e.emp_id END) AS retiring_by_fy30,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.retirement_date <= DATE '2030-03-31' THEN e.emp_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id), 0), 1) AS retirement_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.retirement_date <= DATE '2030-03-31' AND e.current_grade_id IN ('E5', 'E6', 'E7', 'E8', 'E9') THEN e.emp_id END) AS retiring_by_fy30_e5_plus,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.current_grade_id IN ('E0', 'E1', 'E2') THEN e.emp_id END) AS e0_e2_pipeline
FROM employee_master e
JOIN dim_discipline d ON e.discipline_id = d.discipline_id
WHERE e.current_grade_id LIKE 'E%'
  AND d.discipline_id IN ('DISC-DRL', 'DISC-GEO', 'DISC-GPS', 'DISC-GPW', 'DISC-RES', 'DISC-PRD')
  AND LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
GROUP BY d.discipline_id, d.name
ORDER BY retiring_by_fy30 DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C6
-- Question: Which fields or assets were the most profitable and which made losses in FY26?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: result unchanged in substance (the inner join to dim_field already excluded the
-- non-field P&L lines). Hygiene: explicit LOWER(line_type) = 'field', dropped the never-matching '2026'
-- fiscal-year alternate, added PBT margin and a loss flag so "which made losses" is explicit (FY26: 53 fields).

SELECT
    f.name AS field_name,
    wc.short_name AS asset,
    f.onshore_offshore,
    f.maturity,
    pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    pnl.total_opex_inr_cr,
    pnl.ebitda_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr,
    ROUND(pnl.pbt_inr_cr * 100.0 / NULLIF(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr, 0), 1) AS pbt_margin_pct,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr < 0 AS is_loss_making
FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
JOIN dim_field f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON pnl.asset_wc_id = wc.wc_id
WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
  AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'

-- Answer Key SQL: C7
-- Question: Where have we invested the most capex in the last 5 years, and which fields are under-invested relative to their reserves?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: WRONG_QUESTION - the old SQL was a copy of C9 (project cost overruns, 360
-- milestone-duplicated rows) and contained no capex history or reserves. Now: actual capex FY22-FY26 (last 5
-- full FYs; capex_budget, all 12 months each) by asset, its share of the 5-year total, FY26 2P reserves
-- (reserves_annual, a balance -> FY26 only, footnote rows with NULL fiscal_year excluded), capex per MMTOE of
-- 2P reserves, and an under-invested flag = capex intensity below half the average of reserve-holding assets.
-- GAP: capex is recorded by asset/project, not by field, so under-investment is assessed at asset level; the
-- asset's largest 2P field is shown for reference.

WITH capex AS (
    SELECT asset_wc_id, SUM(actual_spend_inr_cr) AS capex_5yr_cr
    FROM capex_budget
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY22', 'FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26')
    GROUP BY asset_wc_id
),
res AS (
    SELECT asset_wc_id, SUM(reserves_2p_total_mmtoe) AS reserves_2p_mmtoe,
           ARRAY_AGG(field_id ORDER BY reserves_2p_total_mmtoe DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS top_field_id
    FROM reserves_annual
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY asset_wc_id
),
j AS (
    SELECT c.asset_wc_id, c.capex_5yr_cr, r.reserves_2p_mmtoe, r.top_field_id
    FROM capex c LEFT JOIN res r ON r.asset_wc_id = c.asset_wc_id
),
avg_int AS (
    SELECT SUM(capex_5yr_cr) / NULLIF(SUM(reserves_2p_mmtoe), 0) AS cr_per_mmtoe_avg
    FROM j WHERE reserves_2p_mmtoe > 0
)
SELECT
    w.short_name AS asset,
    w.type AS wc_type,
    ROUND(j.capex_5yr_cr, 0) AS capex_fy22_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(j.capex_5yr_cr * 100.0 / SUM(j.capex_5yr_cr) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_5yr_capex,
    ROUND(j.reserves_2p_mmtoe, 1) AS reserves_2p_mmtoe_fy26,
    ROUND(j.reserves_2p_mmtoe * 100.0 / SUM(j.reserves_2p_mmtoe) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_2p_reserves,
    ROUND(j.capex_5yr_cr / NULLIF(j.reserves_2p_mmtoe, 0), 1) AS capex_cr_per_mmtoe_2p,
    ROUND(a.cr_per_mmtoe_avg, 1) AS avg_capex_cr_per_mmtoe_2p,
    (j.reserves_2p_mmtoe > 0 AND j.capex_5yr_cr / j.reserves_2p_mmtoe < 0.5 * a.cr_per_mmtoe_avg) AS under_invested,
    f.name AS largest_2p_field
FROM j
CROSS JOIN avg_int a
JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = j.asset_wc_id
LEFT JOIN dim_field f ON f.field_id = j.top_field_id
ORDER BY j.capex_5yr_cr DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C8
-- Question: Which loss-making mature fields are candidates for divestment, a Production Enhancement Contract, or a marginal-field offer?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL returned FY26 PBT < 0 fields only (Champang) with no maturity filter and
-- ignored the candidate flags the question is about. Now: FY26 mature fields that are loss-making (PBT < 0)
-- OR carry a divestment / PEC-monetisation flag in field_pnl_annual, with FY24-FY26 cumulative PBT, the number
-- of loss years in that window, production, and the route implied by the recorded flags.

WITH hist AS (
    SELECT field_id,
           SUM(pbt_inr_cr) AS pbt_fy24_fy26_cr,
           COUNTIF(pbt_inr_cr < 0) AS loss_years_fy24_fy26
    FROM field_pnl_annual
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26') AND LOWER(line_type) = 'field'
    GROUP BY field_id
)
SELECT
    f.name AS field_name,
    wc.short_name AS asset,
    ROUND(pnl.total_production_boe / 1e6, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    pnl.total_opex_inr_cr,
    pnl.ebitda_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr,
    ROUND(h.pbt_fy24_fy26_cr, 2) AS pbt_fy24_fy26_cr,
    h.loss_years_fy24_fy26,
    pnl.is_divestment_candidate,
    pnl.pec_monetisation_potential_flag,
    pnl.is_loss_making_3yr_consecutive,
    CASE WHEN pnl.is_divestment_candidate THEN 'Divestment'
         WHEN pnl.pec_monetisation_potential_flag THEN 'Production Enhancement Contract'
         ELSE 'Marginal-field offer (no flag recorded)' END AS route_from_flags,
    pnl.root_cause_loss_code
FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
JOIN dim_field f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON pnl.asset_wc_id = wc.wc_id
LEFT JOIN hist h ON h.field_id = pnl.field_id
WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
  AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
  AND LOWER(f.maturity) = 'mature'
  AND (pnl.pbt_inr_cr < 0 OR pnl.is_divestment_candidate OR pnl.pec_monetisation_potential_flag)
ORDER BY pnl.pbt_inr_cr ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C9
-- Question: Which major projects are behind schedule or over budget, and by how many crore?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: project_progress has 6 milestone rows per project carrying the same project-level
-- cost and slippage, so the old SQL returned every project 6 times (360 rows) - any total over it is 6x.
-- Now one row per project (values are constant across milestones, verified), with overrun in crore and %,
-- slippage in months, a behind-schedule flag and the count of milestones on the delayed critical path.

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        pp.prj_id,
        ANY_VALUE(pp.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr) AS sanctioned_cost_inr_cr,
        ANY_VALUE(pp.revised_cost_inr_cr) AS revised_cost_inr_cr,
        ANY_VALUE(pp.schedule_slippage_months) AS schedule_slippage_months,
        COUNTIF(LOWER(pp.milestone_status) = 'delayed_critical_path') AS delayed_milestones
    FROM project_progress pp
    GROUP BY pp.prj_id
)
SELECT
    p.prj_id,
    d.name AS project_name,
    d.status,
    p.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr,
    p.revised_cost_inr_cr,
    ROUND(p.revised_cost_inr_cr - p.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr, 2) AS cost_overrun_cr,
    ROUND((p.revised_cost_inr_cr - p.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr, 0), 1) AS cost_overrun_pct,
    p.schedule_slippage_months,
    p.schedule_slippage_months > 0 AS behind_schedule,
    p.delayed_milestones
FROM p
JOIN dim_project d ON d.prj_id = p.prj_id
WHERE p.revised_cost_inr_cr > p.sanctioned_cost_inr_cr OR p.schedule_slippage_months > 0
ORDER BY cost_overrun_cr DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C10
-- Question: How are we tracking against our MoU targets with MoPNG/DPE for this year?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (1) FY_MAPPING - "this year" is FY27 (current FY, 2026-04..2026-09 elapsed); the
-- old SQL reported FY26. FY27 actual_achievement is the full-year projection on the H1 run-rate (e.g. crude
-- 19.051 MMT = 2 x H1 9.525 MMT in production_monthly), so it is labelled as projected. (2) PCT_DENOM - LTIFR is
-- lower-is-better, so actual/target gave 140% "achievement"; it is now inverted (target/actual) for that
-- parameter. Added the recorded rating, Very Good threshold, gap to Excellent and FY26 final rating.

SELECT
    m.parameter_name,
    m.unit_of_measure,
    m.weightage,
    m.excellent_target,
    m.very_good_target,
    m.actual_achievement AS fy27_projected_achievement,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN m.parameter_id = 'MOU-HSE-SAFETY' THEN m.excellent_target * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.actual_achievement, 0)
               ELSE m.actual_achievement * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.excellent_target, 0) END, 1) AS pct_of_excellent,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN m.parameter_id = 'MOU-HSE-SAFETY' THEN m.excellent_target - m.actual_achievement
               ELSE m.actual_achievement - m.excellent_target END, 3) AS gap_to_excellent,
    m.achieved_rating AS fy27_projected_rating,
    p.achieved_rating AS fy26_final_rating,
    m.composite_score AS fy27_composite_to_date,
    m.projected_composite_score AS fy27_projected_composite
FROM mou_targets m
LEFT JOIN mou_targets p ON p.parameter_id = m.parameter_id AND p.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
WHERE m.fiscal_year = 'FY27'
ORDER BY m.weightage DESC, pct_of_excellent ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C11
-- Question: Which assets added headcount but lost production over 5 years?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: headcount is a stock -> compare period-end snapshots
-- (31-Mar-2021 = month 2021-03 vs 31-Mar-2026 = month 2026-03), never SUM across months.
-- Production is a flow -> full-FY sums (both FY21 and FY26 have 12 months), expressed in BOE
-- (total_production_boe) with oil (MMT) and gas (BCM) shown separately, never added together.
-- Criterion: headcount Mar-26 > Mar-21 AND FY26 BOE < FY21 BOE (flag column).

WITH hc AS (
    SELECT
        wc_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2021-03' THEN headcount END) AS hc_mar21,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN headcount END) AS hc_mar26
    FROM headcount_snapshot
    WHERE month IN ('2021-03', '2026-03')
    GROUP BY wc_id
),
prod AS (
    SELECT
        asset_wc_id AS wc_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY21' THEN total_production_boe END) / 1e6 AS mmboe_fy21,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = @fiscal_year THEN total_production_boe END) / 1e6 AS mmboe_fy26,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY21' THEN oil_production_mt END) / 1e6 AS oil_mmt_fy21,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = @fiscal_year THEN oil_production_mt END) / 1e6 AS oil_mmt_fy26,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY21' THEN gas_production_mmscm END) / 1e3 AS gas_bcm_fy21,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = @fiscal_year THEN gas_production_mmscm END) / 1e3 AS gas_bcm_fy26
    FROM production_monthly
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY21', 'FY26')
    GROUP BY asset_wc_id
)
SELECT
    wc.wc_id,
    wc.short_name,
    h.hc_mar21,
    h.hc_mar26,
    h.hc_mar26 - h.hc_mar21 AS hc_change,
    ROUND((h.hc_mar26 - h.hc_mar21) * 100.0 / NULLIF(h.hc_mar21, 0), 2) AS hc_growth_pct,
    ROUND(p.mmboe_fy21, 2) AS mmboe_fy21,
    ROUND(p.mmboe_fy26, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    ROUND((p.mmboe_fy26 - p.mmboe_fy21) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.mmboe_fy21, 0), 2) AS boe_growth_pct,
    ROUND(p.oil_mmt_fy21, 3) AS oil_mmt_fy21,
    ROUND(p.oil_mmt_fy26, 3) AS oil_mmt_fy26,
    ROUND(p.gas_bcm_fy21, 3) AS gas_bcm_fy21,
    ROUND(p.gas_bcm_fy26, 3) AS gas_bcm_fy26,
    (h.hc_mar26 > h.hc_mar21 AND p.mmboe_fy26 < p.mmboe_fy21) AS added_hc_and_lost_production
FROM hc h
JOIN prod p ON h.wc_id = p.wc_id
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON h.wc_id = wc.wc_id
-- All producing assets are returned with the criterion flag so that an empty qualifying set
-- is still an explicit, checkable answer.
ORDER BY added_hc_and_lost_production DESC, boe_growth_pct ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C12
-- Question: What is the manpower cost per barrel of oil equivalent (BOE), by asset?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL computed manpower cost as a % of revenue (not per BOE), at field grain
-- labelled with the asset name (59 rows incl. plant/corporate P&L lines, the same asset repeated). Now: FY26,
-- field P&L lines aggregated to producing asset - allocated manpower cost x 1e7 / total BOE (ratio of sums,
-- MET-FIN-009 pattern) in INR and in USD at the FY26 average INR/USD from dim_price_fx, with headcount and
-- BOE per employee; plus a company line over all producing assets.

WITH a AS (
    SELECT pnl.asset_wc_id,
           SUM(pnl.allocated_manpower_cost_inr_cr) AS manpower_cr,
           SUM(pnl.total_production_boe) AS boe,
           SUM(pnl.regular_employee_headcount) AS regular_headcount
    FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
    WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
    GROUP BY pnl.asset_wc_id
),
fx AS (SELECT AVG(inr_usd_fx_rate) AS fx FROM dim_price_fx WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year),
u AS (
    SELECT wc.short_name AS asset, wc.onshore_offshore, 0 AS ord, a.manpower_cr, a.boe, a.regular_headcount
    FROM a JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = a.asset_wc_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'All producing assets', 'all', 1, SUM(manpower_cr), SUM(boe), SUM(regular_headcount) FROM a
)
SELECT
    u.asset,
    u.onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr, 1) AS manpower_cost_inr_cr,
    ROUND(u.boe / 1e6, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr * 1e7 / NULLIF(u.boe, 0), 0) AS manpower_cost_inr_per_boe,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr * 1e7 / NULLIF(u.boe, 0) / fx.fx, 2) AS manpower_cost_usd_per_boe,
    u.regular_headcount,
    ROUND(u.boe / NULLIF(u.regular_headcount, 0), 0) AS boe_per_employee
FROM u CROSS JOIN fx
ORDER BY u.ord, manpower_cost_usd_per_boe DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C13
-- Question: If we move 200 executives from Delhi/Dehradun to field assets, what changes in cost and coverage?
-- Type: what_if
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL hard-coded the cost (6.50 AS estimated_cta_outlay_cr, i.e. an assumed
-- Rs 3.25 lakh per officer), summed sanctioned/in-position strength over ALL grades for four hand-picked
-- assets, and never allocated the 200 officers. Now a parameterised scenario:
--   * movers: 200 E3-E5 executives (scenario parameter from the question) from WC-DEL + WC-DDN; the source
--     pool size and how many of them are already overdue for rotation (>= 60 months, outside the 3-year
--     pre-retirement protection) are shown;
--   * one-time cost: average actual total transfer cost (transfer grant + CTA + baggage) of E3-E5
--     rotation / hard-station postings in FY24-FY26 from posting_history, x officers allocated;
--   * recurring cost: Special Hard Station Allowance = 10% of basic pay (JRTP Clause 6.3) for officers
--     placed in Category-C assets, using the FY26 average annual basic pay of the Delhi/Dehradun E3-E5 pool;
--   * coverage: the 200 are allocated to field assets (dim_work_centre.type = 'asset') pro-rata to their FY26
--     executive vacancy (sanctioned_posts, E-grades), capped at each asset's vacancy.
-- Salaries move with the officers, so there is no payroll saving; HQ strength falls by the number moved.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20 (alignment with C1/H10/X10): overdue pool also excludes executives whose current
-- posting carries a valid exemption_tag ('None' = no tag; exemption_valid_until >= 2026-10-19 or NULL).

WITH params AS (SELECT 200 AS officers),
pool AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS source_pool_e3_e5,
        COUNT(DISTINCT IF(v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months AND DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) > 3 * 365.25 AND ex.emp_id IS NULL, e.emp_id, NULL)) AS source_pool_overdue
    FROM employee_master e
    LEFT JOIN `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v ON v.emp_id = e.emp_id AND v.is_current_stay
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT emp_id FROM posting_history WHERE is_current_posting = TRUE AND NULLIF(exemption_tag, 'None') IS NOT NULL
               AND (exemption_valid_until >= DATE '2026-10-19' OR exemption_valid_until IS NULL)) ex ON ex.emp_id = e.emp_id
    WHERE LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active' AND e.current_wc_id IN ( @wc_id, 'WC-DDN') AND e.current_grade_id IN ('E3', 'E4', 'E5')
),
basic AS (
    SELECT SUM(p.basic_pay_inr) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.emp_id) AS avg_annual_basic_inr
    FROM payroll_monthly p
    JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id
    WHERE p.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND p.grade_id IN ('E3', 'E4', 'E5') AND p.wc_id IN ('WC-DEL', 'WC-DDN')
),
tcost AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_transfer_cost_inr) AS avg_transfer_cost_inr
    FROM posting_history
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26') AND grade_id IN ('E3', 'E4', 'E5')
      AND LOWER(posting_type) IN ('rotation', 'hard_station') AND total_transfer_cost_inr > 0
),
vac AS (
    SELECT w.wc_id, w.short_name, w.hard_station_cat,
           SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength) AS exec_sanctioned, SUM(sp.in_position_strength) AS exec_in_position, SUM(sp.vacancy_count) AS exec_vacancy
    FROM sanctioned_posts sp
    JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = sp.wc_id
    WHERE sp.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND sp.grade_id LIKE 'E%' AND LOWER(w.type) = 'asset'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING SUM(sp.vacancy_count) > 0
),
alloc AS (
    SELECT v.*, LEAST(v.exec_vacancy, CAST(ROUND(p.officers * v.exec_vacancy / SUM(v.exec_vacancy) OVER ()) AS INT64)) AS allocated_officers
    FROM vac v CROSS JOIN params p
),
rows_ AS (
    SELECT 'receiving_asset' AS section, 0 AS ord, a.short_name AS entity, a.hard_station_cat,
           a.exec_sanctioned, a.exec_in_position, a.exec_vacancy, a.allocated_officers,
           a.allocated_officers * t.avg_transfer_cost_inr / 1e7 AS one_time_cost_cr,
           IF(a.hard_station_cat = 'C', a.allocated_officers * b.avg_annual_basic_inr * 0.10 / 1e7, 0) AS annual_allowance_cr
    FROM alloc a CROSS JOIN tcost t CROSS JOIN basic b
)
SELECT
    r.section, r.entity, r.hard_station_cat, r.exec_sanctioned, r.exec_in_position, r.exec_vacancy, r.allocated_officers,
    r.exec_vacancy - r.allocated_officers AS vacancy_after_move,
    ROUND(r.exec_in_position * 100.0 / NULLIF(r.exec_sanctioned, 0), 1) AS fill_pct_before,
    ROUND((r.exec_in_position + r.allocated_officers) * 100.0 / NULLIF(r.exec_sanctioned, 0), 1) AS fill_pct_after,
    ROUND(r.one_time_cost_cr, 2) AS one_time_transfer_cost_cr,
    ROUND(r.annual_allowance_cr, 2) AS annual_hard_station_allowance_cr,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS source_pool_e3_e5, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS source_pool_overdue,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS avg_transfer_cost_lakh
FROM rows_ r
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'scenario_total', 'All receiving field assets', NULL,
    SUM(r.exec_sanctioned), SUM(r.exec_in_position), SUM(r.exec_vacancy), SUM(r.allocated_officers),
    SUM(r.exec_vacancy) - SUM(r.allocated_officers),
    ROUND(SUM(r.exec_in_position) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(r.exec_sanctioned), 0), 1),
    ROUND((SUM(r.exec_in_position) + SUM(r.allocated_officers)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(r.exec_sanctioned), 0), 1),
    ROUND(SUM(r.one_time_cost_cr), 2), ROUND(SUM(r.annual_allowance_cr), 2),
    ANY_VALUE(pool.source_pool_e3_e5), ANY_VALUE(pool.source_pool_overdue),
    ROUND(ANY_VALUE(t.avg_transfer_cost_inr) / 1e5, 2)
FROM rows_ r CROSS JOIN pool CROSS JOIN tcost t
ORDER BY section, allocated_officers DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: C14
-- Question: Prepare a one-page board note on the top 5 loss-making fields: production, cost, staffing and a recommendation.
-- Type: document
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL returned only revenue/opex/EBITDA/PBT for the five lowest-PBT fields - no
-- production, staffing or recommendation inputs - and the legacy board-note text called all five "top
-- operating losses" although only one (Champang) is PBT-negative in FY26. Now the five lowest-PBT FY26 fields
-- (field lines only) with production (MMboe), revenue, opex, manpower cost, EBITDA, PBT, regular and contract
-- headcount, lifting cost (USD/BOE, from field_pnl_annual), monetisation flags, root cause and the recorded
-- 5-year PEC/farm-out payoff, plus a loss flag so the note can state how many are actually loss-making.

SELECT
    f.name AS field_name,
    wc.short_name AS asset,
    f.maturity,
    ROUND(pnl.total_production_boe / 1e6, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    pnl.total_opex_inr_cr,
    pnl.allocated_manpower_cost_inr_cr,
    pnl.ebitda_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr < 0 AS is_loss_making,
    pnl.regular_employee_headcount,
    pnl.contractor_headcount,
    pnl.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd,
    pnl.manpower_cost_per_boe_usd,
    pnl.pec_monetisation_potential_flag,
    pnl.is_divestment_candidate,
    pnl.root_cause_loss_code,
    pnl.projected_pec_farmout_payoff_5yr_inr_cr
FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
JOIN dim_field f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON pnl.asset_wc_id = wc.wc_id
WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
  AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
ORDER BY pnl.pbt_inr_cr ASC
LIMIT 5;

-- Answer Key SQL: H1
-- Question: List the executives with more than 3 years at their current station (rotation policy), by asset and grade.
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted ALL current executives per WC/grade (no tenure test, LIMIT 20). Now: active executives
-- (cadre='executive') whose continuous stay at the current work centre began more than 3 years before 2026-10-19
-- (posting islands, so in-place promotions do not reset station tenure); all WC x grade rows, no LIMIT.
WITH numbered_postings AS (
    SELECT
        p.emp_id, p.wc_id, p.from_date, p.is_current_posting, p.grade_id,
        -- exemption columns hold the literal string 'None' when no exemption exists
        IF(LOWER(IFNULL(p.exemption_tag, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), NULL, p.exemption_tag) AS exemption_tag,
        IF(LOWER(IFNULL(p.exemption_reason_code, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), NULL, p.exemption_reason_code) AS exemption_reason_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.emp_id ORDER BY p.from_date, p.posting_id) -
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.emp_id, p.wc_id ORDER BY p.from_date, p.posting_id) AS island_id
    FROM posting_history p
),
current_station AS (
    -- continuous stay at the current work centre (in-place promotions do not reset station tenure)
    SELECT
        emp_id, wc_id,
        MIN(from_date) AS station_from_date,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, grade_id, NULL)) AS grade_id,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, exemption_tag, NULL)) AS exemption_tag,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, exemption_reason_code, NULL)) AS exemption_reason_code
    FROM numbered_postings
    GROUP BY emp_id, wc_id, island_id
    HAVING LOGICAL_OR(is_current_posting)
),
active_execs AS (
    SELECT cs.*, e.age_years, e.discipline_id,
           DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', cs.station_from_date, MONTH) AS station_tenure_months,
           cs.station_from_date < DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-10-19', INTERVAL 3 YEAR) AS over_3_years
    FROM current_station cs
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = cs.grade_id
    JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = cs.emp_id
    WHERE LOWER(g.cadre) = 'executive'
      AND LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
)
SELECT
    wc.short_name AS work_centre,
    wc.hard_station_cat,
    ae.grade_id,
    COUNT(*) AS executives_over_3y,
    ROUND(AVG(ae.station_tenure_months) / 12, 1) AS avg_station_years,
    COUNTIF(ae.exemption_tag IS NOT NULL) AS with_recorded_exemption,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY wc.short_name) AS work_centre_total_over_3y,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS company_total_over_3y,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_execs) AS company_active_executives
FROM active_execs ae
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = ae.wc_id
WHERE ae.over_3_years
GROUP BY wc.short_name, wc.hard_station_cat, ae.grade_id
ORDER BY work_centre_total_over_3y DESC, wc.short_name, executives_over_3y DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: H2
-- Question: Which employees have never served in a hard or remote station?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted executives CURRENTLY posted in 4 NE work centres (the opposite population).
-- Now: active employees with no posting ever in a Category C (hard/remote) work centre, by grade, with share of grade.
WITH ever_hard AS (
    -- 'hard or remote station' = Category C work centre (JRTP 2.0/6.1: NE, offshore, Bokaro CBM, Rajasthan)
    SELECT p.emp_id, LOGICAL_OR(LOWER(w.hard_station_cat) = 'c') AS served_cat_c
    FROM posting_history p
    JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = p.wc_id
    GROUP BY p.emp_id
),
active AS (
    SELECT e.*, g.cadre, g.level_order, g.typical_residency_years,
           NOT IFNULL(h.served_cat_c, FALSE) AS never_hard
    FROM employee_master e
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = e.current_grade_id
    LEFT JOIN ever_hard h ON h.emp_id = e.emp_id
    WHERE LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
)
SELECT
    cadre,
    current_grade_id AS grade_id,
    COUNTIF(never_hard) AS never_served_hard_station,
    COUNT(*) AS active_employees,
    ROUND(COUNTIF(never_hard) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_of_grade,
    SUM(COUNTIF(never_hard)) OVER () AS company_never_hard,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS company_active,
    SUM(COUNTIF(never_hard AND LOWER(cadre) = 'executive')) OVER () AS executives_never_hard
FROM active
GROUP BY cadre, current_grade_id, level_order
ORDER BY level_order;

-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL averaged row-level vacancy_rate_pct (unweighted mean of tiny category cells) and

-- Answer Key SQL: H4
-- Question: What are attrition and voluntary-exit numbers by grade over the last 3 years? Is mid-career attrition (E3–E5) rising?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted only resignations (no total attrition, no VRS, no rates), so 'rising' could not be
-- judged against a shrinking base. Now: per grade, FY24-FY26 (last 3 full FYs) total separations, voluntary exits
-- (resignation + VRS) and voluntary-exit rate on opening headcount (headcount_snapshot March of the prior FY, a stock).
WITH seps AS (
    SELECT last_grade_id AS grade_id, fiscal_year,
           COUNT(*) AS total_exits,
           COUNTIF(LOWER(separation_type) IN ('resignation', 'vrs')) AS voluntary_exits
    FROM separations
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
opening AS (
    SELECT grade_id,
           CASE month WHEN '2023-03' THEN 'FY24' WHEN '2024-03' THEN 'FY25' WHEN '2025-03' THEN 'FY26' END AS fiscal_year,
           SUM(headcount) AS opening_hc
    FROM headcount_snapshot
    WHERE month IN ('2023-03', '2024-03', '2025-03')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
grid AS (
    SELECT o.grade_id, o.fiscal_year, o.opening_hc, IFNULL(s.total_exits, 0) AS total_exits, IFNULL(s.voluntary_exits, 0) AS voluntary_exits
    FROM opening o LEFT JOIN seps s ON s.grade_id = o.grade_id AND s.fiscal_year = o.fiscal_year
)
SELECT
    g.grade_id,
    g.grade_id IN ('E3', 'E4', 'E5') AS is_mid_career,
    SUM(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY24', total_exits, 0)) AS total_exits_fy24,
    SUM(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY25', total_exits, 0)) AS total_exits_fy25,
    SUM(IF(fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, total_exits, 0)) AS total_exits_fy26,
    SUM(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY24', voluntary_exits, 0)) AS voluntary_fy24,

-- Answer Key SQL: H5
-- Question: How many DPC (promotion) cases are pending, and for how long?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL used delay_months >= 6 as the 'pending' test and gave no duration. Now: pending = status
-- 'delayed' (DPC not held; same 228 cases), by promotion step, with recorded delay_months (stale extract value) AND months
-- overdue since due_date as of 2026-10-19.
SELECT
    from_grade_id,
    to_grade_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS pending_candidates,
    MIN(due_date) AS earliest_due_date,
    ROUND(AVG(delay_months), 1) AS avg_recorded_delay_months,
    MAX(delay_months) AS max_recorded_delay_months,
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', due_date, MONTH)), 1) AS avg_months_overdue_asof_2026_10_19,
    MAX(DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', due_date, MONTH)) AS max_months_overdue_asof_2026_10_19,
    SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id)) OVER () AS total_pending
FROM dpc_cases
WHERE LOWER(status) = 'delayed' AND held_date IS NULL
GROUP BY from_grade_id, to_grade_id
ORDER BY from_grade_id;

-- Answer Key SQL: H6
-- Question: Are we compliant with reservation norms (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD) by grade?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL LEFT JOINed employee_master on discipline_id (fan-out weighting every cell by the
-- discipline's headcount) and reported fill rate (in-position/sanctioned) instead of representation vs norm; PwD absent.
-- Now: FY26 in-position representation of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD as % of the grade's in-position strength vs statutory norm,
-- with backlog reserved vacancies, by grade (board posts excluded).
WITH posts AS (
    SELECT sp.*,
           IF(LOWER(IFNULL(sp.pwd_category, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), FALSE, TRUE) AS is_pwd
    FROM sanctioned_posts sp
    WHERE sp.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
),
by_cat AS (
    SELECT grade_id, social_category AS category, SUM(sanctioned_strength) AS sanctioned, SUM(in_position_strength) AS in_position,
           SUM(vacancy_count) AS vacancies, SUM(backlog_vacancies) AS backlog_vacancies
    FROM posts WHERE LOWER(social_category) IN ('sc', 'st', 'obc', 'ews')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT grade_id, 'PwD', SUM(sanctioned_strength), SUM(in_position_strength), SUM(vacancy_count), SUM(backlog_vacancies)
    FROM posts WHERE is_pwd
    GROUP BY 1
),
grade_tot AS (
    SELECT grade_id, SUM(in_position_strength) AS grade_in_position, SUM(sanctioned_strength) AS grade_sanctioned
    FROM posts GROUP BY 1
),
norms AS (
    -- statutory reservation norms (DoPT / Presidential directives): SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC 27%, EWS 10%, PwD 4%
    SELECT 'SC' AS category, 15.0 AS norm_pct UNION ALL SELECT 'ST', 7.5 UNION ALL SELECT 'OBC', 27.0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'EWS', 10.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PwD', 4.0
)
SELECT
    c.grade_id,
    c.category,
    c.in_position,
    t.grade_in_position,
    ROUND(c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position, 1) AS representation_pct,
    n.norm_pct,
    ROUND(c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position - n.norm_pct, 1) AS gap_vs_norm_pp,
    c.backlog_vacancies,
    c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position >= n.norm_pct AS meets_norm
FROM by_cat c
JOIN grade_tot t ON t.grade_id = c.grade_id
JOIN norms n ON n.category = c.category
JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = c.grade_id
WHERE LOWER(g.cadre) <> 'board'
ORDER BY g.level_order, n.norm_pct DESC, c.category;

-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL LEFT JOINed employee_master on discipline_id (fan-out weighting every cell by the
-- discipline's headcount) and reported fill rate (in-position/sanctioned) instead of representation vs norm; PwD absent.
-- Now: FY26 in-position representation of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD as % of the grade's in-position strength vs statutory norm,
-- with backlog reserved vacancies, by grade (board posts excluded).
WITH posts AS (
    SELECT sp.*,
           IF(LOWER(IFNULL(sp.pwd_category, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), FALSE, TRUE) AS is_pwd
    FROM sanctioned_posts sp
    WHERE sp.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
),
by_cat AS (
    SELECT grade_id, social_category AS category, SUM(sanctioned_strength) AS sanctioned, SUM(in_position_strength) AS in_position,
           SUM(vacancy_count) AS vacancies, SUM(backlog_vacancies) AS backlog_vacancies
    FROM posts WHERE LOWER(social_category) IN ('sc', 'st', 'obc', 'ews')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT grade_id, 'PwD', SUM(sanctioned_strength), SUM(in_position_strength), SUM(vacancy_count), SUM(backlog_vacancies)
    FROM posts WHERE is_pwd
    GROUP BY 1
),
grade_tot AS (
    SELECT grade_id, SUM(in_position_strength) AS grade_in_position, SUM(sanctioned_strength) AS grade_sanctioned
    FROM posts GROUP BY 1
),
norms AS (
    -- statutory reservation norms (DoPT / Presidential directives): SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC 27%, EWS 10%, PwD 4%
    SELECT 'SC' AS category, 15.0 AS norm_pct UNION ALL SELECT 'ST', 7.5 UNION ALL SELECT 'OBC', 27.0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'EWS', 10.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PwD', 4.0
)
SELECT
    c.grade_id,
    c.category,
    c.in_position,
    t.grade_in_position,
    ROUND(c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position, 1) AS representation_pct,
    n.norm_pct,
    ROUND(c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position - n.norm_pct, 1) AS gap_vs_norm_pp,
    c.backlog_vacancies,
    c.in_position * 100.0 / t.grade_in_position >= n.norm_pct AS meets_norm
FROM by_cat c
JOIN grade_tot t ON t.grade_id = c.grade_id
JOIN norms n ON n.category = c.category
JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = c.grade_id
WHERE LOWER(g.cadre) <> 'board'
ORDER BY g.level_order, n.norm_pct DESC, c.category;

),
offshore_trend AS (

    FROM headcount_snapshot h

    WHERE LOWER(w.onshore_offshore) = 'offshore'

    GROUP BY h.month
)
SELECT '1. Company' AS dimension, 'All active employees' AS label, 0 AS sort_key,

FROM act
UNION ALL
SELECT '2. Grade', current_grade_id, MIN(level_order),
       COUNTIF(LOWER(gender) = 'female'), COUNT(*), ROUND(COUNTIF(LOWER(gender) = 'female') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1)

UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT '4. Offshore trend (headcount snapshot)', month, 0, women, total, ROUND(women * 100.0 / total, 1)

SELECT '5. Asset', short_name, 0,

-- Answer Key SQL: H8
-- Question: What were training hours per executive last year, and which disciplines are below target?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL averaged hours per training RECORD for all employees (incl. non-executives) and defined
-- no target. Now: FY26 (last full FY) training hours per executive on rolls at 31-Mar-2026 (untrained executives count as 0),
-- per trained executive (MET-HR-037) and a below-company-average flag. No discipline-level training target exists in the
-- data (GAP), so the company executive average is the benchmark.
WITH execs AS (
    -- executives on rolls at FY26 end (31-Mar-2026): active today or separated after FY26
    SELECT e.emp_id, e.discipline_id, e.current_wc_id
    FROM employee_master e
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = e.current_grade_id
    WHERE LOWER(g.cadre) = 'executive'
      AND (LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active' OR e.separation_date > DATE '2026-03-31')
),
tr AS (
    SELECT emp_id, SUM(training_hours) AS hours
    FROM training_records
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY emp_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT x.*, IFNULL(t.hours, 0) AS hours, t.emp_id IS NOT NULL AS trained
    FROM execs x LEFT JOIN tr t ON t.emp_id = x.emp_id
)
SELECT
    d.name AS discipline,
    COUNT(*) AS executives,
    COUNTIF(b.trained) AS trained_executives,
    ROUND(SUM(b.hours), 1) AS total_hours,
    ROUND(SUM(b.hours) / COUNT(*), 1) AS hours_per_executive,
    ROUND(SUM(b.hours) / NULLIF(COUNTIF(b.trained), 0), 1) AS hours_per_trained_executive,
    ROUND(SUM(SUM(b.hours)) OVER () / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS company_hours_per_executive,
    SUM(b.hours) / COUNT(*) < SUM(SUM(b.hours)) OVER () / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS below_company_average
FROM base b
JOIN dim_discipline d ON d.discipline_id = b.discipline_id
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY hours_per_executive;

-- Answer Key SQL: H9
-- Question: How many grievances and service litigations are pending, and how old are they?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted only status 'pending' (68 'stayed' cases are also undisposed/sub judice) and gave
-- no age profile or case-type split. Now: open = pending + stayed, by case type, with ageing computed from filing_date as of
-- 2026-10-19; 11 cases carry filing dates AFTER 2026-10-19 (data defect) and are counted separately, excluded from ages.
WITH open_cases AS (
    SELECT case_type, LOWER(status) AS status, filing_date,
           DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', filing_date, DAY) AS age_days_asof
    FROM grievances_litigation
    WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('pending', 'stayed')
)
SELECT
    case_type,
    COUNT(*) AS open_cases,
    COUNTIF(status = 'stayed') AS of_which_stayed,
    COUNTIF(age_days_asof BETWEEN 0 AND 364) AS aged_under_1y,
    COUNTIF(age_days_asof BETWEEN 365 AND 1095) AS aged_1_to_3y,
    COUNTIF(age_days_asof > 1095) AS aged_over_3y,
    COUNTIF(age_days_asof < 0) AS future_dated_filings,
    ROUND(AVG(IF(age_days_asof >= 0, age_days_asof, NULL)) / 365.25, 1) AS avg_age_years,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_open,
    SUM(COUNTIF(age_days_asof > 1095)) OVER () AS total_over_3y
FROM open_cases
GROUP BY case_type
ORDER BY open_cases DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: H10
-- Question: Generate an Excel transfer proposal for FY27 using rotation rules.
-- Type: document
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted ALL employees (incl. non-executives, exempt and age 57+) with >=36 months per WC, and
-- the legacy document prose reported the 46-row count as '{eligible_officers_count}'.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20 (rev 2, coordinator): 'due' redefined per JRTP 3.1/3.2 and C1/MET-HR-011 as continuous stay >= 60
-- months (hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay) with no valid exemption and not within 3 yrs of superannuation; 3-5 yr stays shown
-- separately as eligible_3_to_5y; stays starting exactly 2020-07-01 (left-censored posting history) counted per WC.
WITH stay AS (
    -- current continuous stay per hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay (same source as C1 / MET-HR-011)
    SELECT v.emp_id, v.wc_id, v.grade_id, v.discipline_id, v.retirement_date,
           v.continuous_from_date, v.continuous_stay_months,
           IF(LOWER(IFNULL(p.exemption_tag, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), NULL, p.exemption_tag) AS exemption_tag,
           p.exemption_valid_until
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = v.grade_id
    JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = v.emp_id
    LEFT JOIN posting_history p ON p.emp_id = v.emp_id AND p.is_current_posting
    WHERE v.is_current_stay
      AND LOWER(g.cadre) = 'executive'
      AND LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
),
ever_hard AS (
    SELECT p.emp_id, LOGICAL_OR(LOWER(w.hard_station_cat) = 'c') AS served_cat_c
    FROM posting_history p JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = p.wc_id
    GROUP BY p.emp_id
),
rotation AS (
    -- JRTP 3.1/3.2: 3 yrs is the MINIMUM; rotation normally after 3-5 yrs -> 'due' = continuous stay >= 60 months (C1 rule).
    -- Protected: within 3 yrs of superannuation (JRTP 7.1, C1 rule: retirement_date - 2026-10-19 <= 3*365.25 days)
    -- or a recorded exemption still valid on 2026-10-19.
    SELECT s.*, IFNULL(h.served_cat_c, FALSE) AS served_cat_c,
           DATE_DIFF(s.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 3 * 365.25 AS retiring_3y,

-- Answer Key SQL: F1
-- Question: What is the lifting cost ($/bbl) by asset, and which assets are above the company average?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: was an unweighted AVG of field-level $/BOE ratios with no company average and no
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: above/below flag. Now production-weighted (opex / BOE) per asset for FY26 (last full FY),
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: field lines only, compared with the production-weighted company average across all fields.

WITH asset AS (
    SELECT
        pnl.asset_wc_id,
        wc.short_name AS asset_name,
        wc.onshore_offshore,
        SUM(pnl.total_production_boe) AS boe,
        SUM(pnl.total_opex_inr_cr) AS opex_cr,
        SUM(pnl.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd * pnl.total_production_boe) AS usd_x_boe
    FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
    JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON pnl.asset_wc_id = wc.wc_id
    WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
      AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
      AND pnl.total_production_boe > 0
    GROUP BY pnl.asset_wc_id, wc.short_name, wc.onshore_offshore
),
company AS (
    SELECT ROUND(SUM(usd_x_boe) / SUM(boe), 2) AS company_avg_usd_boe FROM asset
)
SELECT
    a.asset_wc_id,
    a.asset_name,
    a.onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(a.boe / 1e6, 2) AS production_mmboe,
    ROUND(a.opex_cr, 1) AS opex_inr_cr,
    ROUND(a.usd_x_boe / a.boe, 2) AS lifting_cost_usd_boe,
    ROUND(a.opex_cr * 1e7 / a.boe, 0) AS lifting_cost_inr_boe,
    c.company_avg_usd_boe,
    ROUND(a.usd_x_boe / a.boe, 2) > c.company_avg_usd_boe AS above_company_avg
FROM asset a
CROSS JOIN company c
ORDER BY lifting_cost_usd_boe DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: F2
-- Question: What is capex utilisation (budget vs. revised estimate vs. actual) by asset for the current year?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: was a list of project_progress milestone rows with RCE > sanctioned cost (6 duplicate
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: milestone rows per project, no BE/RE/actual, no current-year filter). Now capex_budget for
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: the current FY27 year-to-date (Apr-Sep 2026, 6 months; BE/RE are phased monthly) by asset:
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: BE, RE, actual, utilisation vs BE and vs RE.

SELECT
    cb.asset_wc_id,
    wc.short_name AS asset_name,
    wc.onshore_offshore,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cb.prj_id) AS projects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cb.month) AS months_covered,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.budget_estimate_be_inr_cr), 1) AS be_ytd_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.revised_estimate_re_inr_cr), 1) AS re_ytd_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.actual_spend_inr_cr), 1) AS actual_ytd_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.actual_spend_inr_cr) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(cb.budget_estimate_be_inr_cr), 0), 1) AS utilisation_vs_be_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.actual_spend_inr_cr) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(cb.revised_estimate_re_inr_cr), 0), 1) AS utilisation_vs_re_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(cb.actual_spend_inr_cr) - SUM(cb.budget_estimate_be_inr_cr), 1) AS variance_vs_be_cr
FROM capex_budget cb
LEFT JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = cb.asset_wc_id
WHERE cb.fiscal_year = 'FY27'
GROUP BY cb.asset_wc_id, wc.short_name, wc.onshore_offshore
ORDER BY actual_ytd_cr DESC;

-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: was SUM(statutory_levies) for FY26 LEFT JOINed to 12 monthly price rows (12x fan-out:
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Rs 3,11,988 cr vs actual 25,999 cr) and in crore, not per barrel. Now per-barrel levies
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: from price_fx_monthly: 'this year' = FY27 YTD (Apr-Sep 2026, 6 months) with FY26 and FY25
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (SAED year) for context; monthly per-bbl rates averaged within each FY.

SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    COUNT(*) AS months_covered,
    ROUND(AVG(brent_usd_bbl), 2) AS brent_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl), 2) AS gross_realisation_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(royalty_per_barrel_usd), 2) AS royalty_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(cess_per_barrel_usd), 2) AS oidb_cess_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl), 2) AS saed_windfall_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(royalty_per_barrel_usd + cess_per_barrel_usd + windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl), 2) AS total_levies_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl - royalty_per_barrel_usd - cess_per_barrel_usd - windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl), 2) AS post_levy_realisation_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(royalty_per_barrel_usd + cess_per_barrel_usd + windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl) * 100
          / AVG(ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl), 1) AS levies_pct_of_realisation,
    ROUND(AVG((royalty_per_barrel_usd + cess_per_barrel_usd + windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl) * inr_usd_fx_rate), 0) AS total_levies_inr_bbl
FROM price_fx_monthly
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY25', @fiscal_year, 'FY27')
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: F5
-- Question: Which contracts or vendors make up the top 80% of spend, and where were the cost overruns?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: was every vendor alphabetically with LIMIT 100 (no Pareto cut), grouped by vendor NAME
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (2,000 vendor_ids share 1,975 names -> merged vendors), raw rupees. Now FY26 (last full FY)
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: paid spend by vendor_id, cumulative share, and only vendors inside the top 80% of spend
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (incl. the vendor that crosses 80%), with cost overrun (revised - original PO) in crore.

WITH v AS (
    SELECT
        po.vendor_id,
        SUM(po.actual_paid_amount_inr) / 1e7 AS paid_cr,
        SUM(po.original_po_value_inr) / 1e7 AS original_po_cr,
        SUM(po.cost_overrun_inr) / 1e7 AS overrun_cr,
        COUNTIF(po.cost_overrun_inr > 0) AS overrun_lines,
        COUNT(DISTINCT po.po_number) AS pos
    FROM purchase_orders po
    WHERE po.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY po.vendor_id
),
r AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY paid_cr DESC, vendor_id) AS spend_rank,
        SUM(paid_cr) OVER (ORDER BY paid_cr DESC, vendor_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
            / SUM(paid_cr) OVER () * 100 AS cum_share_pct,
        SUM(paid_cr) OVER () AS total_paid_cr,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_vendors,
        SUM(overrun_cr) OVER () AS total_overrun_cr
    FROM v
)
SELECT
    r.spend_rank,
    r.vendor_id,
    d.name AS vendor_name,
    d.category AS vendor_category,
    r.pos,
    ROUND(r.paid_cr, 2) AS paid_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(r.cum_share_pct, 2) AS cum_share_pct,
    ROUND(r.overrun_cr, 2) AS cost_overrun_cr,
    ROUND(r.overrun_cr * 100 / NULLIF(r.original_po_cr, 0), 2) AS overrun_pct_of_po,
    r.overrun_lines,
    ROUND(r.total_paid_cr, 0) AS total_paid_all_vendors_cr,
    r.total_vendors,
    ROUND(r.total_overrun_cr, 1) AS total_overrun_all_vendors_cr
FROM r
LEFT JOIN dim_vendor d ON d.vendor_id = r.vendor_id
WHERE r.cum_share_pct - r.paid_cr / r.total_paid_cr * 100 < 80
ORDER BY r.spend_rank;

-- Answer Key SQL: F6
-- Question: How old are receivables from oil marketing companies and gas buyers, by customer?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: was customer x bucket rows ordered alphabetically with LIMIT 100 (125 combinations exist ->
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: 25 rows silently dropped). Now one row per customer with the aging buckets pivoted, total,
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: >90-day share and disputed amount. Balances are as at 31-Mar-2026 (only FY26 invoices carry
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: outstanding; aging_days is measured from invoice date to FY26 year-end).

SELECT
    c.short_name AS customer,
    c.type AS customer_type,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r.product_type, ', ') AS products,
    ROUND(SUM(r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr), 1) AS outstanding_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days <= 30, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS d0_30_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days BETWEEN 31 AND 60, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS d31_60_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days BETWEEN 61 AND 90, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS d61_90_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS d91_180_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days > 180, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS d180_plus_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.aging_days > 90, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)) * 100 / SUM(r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr), 1) AS over_90d_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(r.is_disputed, r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr, 0)), 1) AS disputed_cr
FROM receivables r
LEFT JOIN dim_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE r.outstanding_amount_inr_cr > 0
GROUP BY c.short_name, c.type
ORDER BY outstanding_cr DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: F7
-- Question: What is the employee cost as a percentage of revenue, by asset, and how has it trended?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: grouped by asset name AND field values, so it returned one row per field labelled with the
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: asset name (295 rows, several per asset-year; corporate/plant lines with zero revenue mixed
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: in). Now aggregated to asset (field lines only): allocated manpower cost / gross revenue
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: for each FY21-FY26 (5-year trend) plus FY26 cost and revenue and the FY21->FY26 change.

WITH a AS (
    SELECT
        pnl.asset_wc_id,
        pnl.fiscal_year,
        SUM(pnl.allocated_manpower_cost_inr_cr) AS mp,
        SUM(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr) AS rev
    FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
    WHERE LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
      AND pnl.fiscal_year IN ('FY21', 'FY22', 'FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26')
    GROUP BY pnl.asset_wc_id, pnl.fiscal_year
)
SELECT
    wc.short_name AS asset_name,
    wc.onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.mp, 0)), 1) AS manpower_cost_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.rev, 0)), 0) AS revenue_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY21', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY21', a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy21,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY22', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY22', a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy22,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY23', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY23', a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy23,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY24', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY24', a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy24,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY25', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY25', a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy25,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.rev, 0))) * 100, 1) AS pct_fy26,
    ROUND((SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, a.rev, 0)))
         - SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY21', a.mp, 0)), SUM(IF(a.fiscal_year = 'FY21', a.rev, 0)))) * 100, 1) AS change_fy21_fy26_pp
FROM a
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON a.asset_wc_id = wc.wc_id
GROUP BY wc.short_name, wc.onshore_offshore
ORDER BY pct_fy26 DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: F8
-- Question: What is the finding & development cost and reserve replacement ratio, by basin?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: RRR was an unweighted AVG of field ratios; now basin RRR = SUM(2P accretion) / SUM(production)
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (MMTOE, FY26), F&D costs accretion-weighted, plus production, accretion and a company row.

WITH b AS (
    SELECT
        basin_name,
        SUM(annual_production_mmtoe) AS prod,
        SUM(gross_reserves_accretion_mmtoe) AS acc,
        SUM(finding_cost_usd_per_boe * gross_reserves_accretion_mmtoe) AS fc_x,
        SUM(development_cost_usd_per_boe * gross_reserves_accretion_mmtoe) AS dc_x,
        SUM(reserves_2p_total_mmtoe) AS r2p
    FROM reserves_annual
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY basin_name
),
u AS (
    SELECT * FROM b
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ALL BASINS', SUM(prod), SUM(acc), SUM(fc_x), SUM(dc_x), SUM(r2p) FROM b
)
SELECT
    basin_name,
    ROUND(prod, 2) AS production_mmtoe,
    ROUND(acc, 2) AS reserve_accretion_2p_mmtoe,
    ROUND(acc / NULLIF(prod, 0), 2) AS rrr_2p,
    ROUND(fc_x / NULLIF(acc, 0), 2) AS finding_cost_usd_boe,
    ROUND(dc_x / NULLIF(acc, 0), 2) AS development_cost_usd_boe,
    ROUND((fc_x + dc_x) / NULLIF(acc, 0), 2) AS fd_cost_usd_boe,
    ROUND(r2p, 1) AS reserves_2p_mmtoe
FROM u
ORDER BY basin_name = 'ALL BASINS', fd_cost_usd_boe DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: F9
-- Question: What are the forex exposure and hedging position on dollar-linked contracts?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: unlabelled sums in raw USD by currency only. Now FY26 active book by currency pair in USD
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: million: gross exposure, hedged via derivatives vs natural hedge (crude-sales designated),
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: unhedged, hedge ratio and MTM (Rs cr). Non-USD exposures are stated in USD equivalent.

SELECT
    COALESCE(fh.currency_pair, 'ALL CURRENCIES') AS currency_pair,
    COUNT(*) AS positions,
    ROUND(SUM(gross_exposure_usd) / 1e6, 1) AS gross_exposure_usd_mn,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(LOWER(instrument_type) LIKE 'natural_hedge%', hedged_amount_usd, 0)) / 1e6, 1) AS natural_hedge_usd_mn,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(LOWER(instrument_type) NOT LIKE 'natural_hedge%', hedged_amount_usd, 0)) / 1e6, 1) AS derivative_hedged_usd_mn,
    ROUND(SUM(unhedged_exposure_usd) / 1e6, 1) AS unhedged_usd_mn,
    ROUND(SUM(hedged_amount_usd) * 100 / SUM(gross_exposure_usd), 1) AS hedge_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(mtm_gain_loss_inr_cr), 1) AS mtm_gain_loss_inr_cr
FROM forex_hedges fh
WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(hedge_status) = 'active'
GROUP BY ROLLUP (fh.currency_pair)
ORDER BY GROUPING(fh.currency_pair), gross_exposure_usd_mn DESC;

-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: into 19 'work centres'. No quarterly P&L table exists (GAP), so FY26 (last full FY) field-line
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: P&L per producing asset is phased into quarters: oil revenue by monthly (oil+condensate) x
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: ONGC crude realisation, gas revenue by monthly gas volume x APM price x FX, royalty/SAED by
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: gross-revenue share, cess by oil share, opex by the cost_ledger quarterly profile of the asset
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (even if absent), DD&A evenly. Quarters sum exactly to the annual field P&L.

WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        p.asset_wc_id,
        CASE WHEN SUBSTR(p.month, 6, 2) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN 'Q1'
             WHEN SUBSTR(p.month, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') THEN 'Q2'
             WHEN SUBSTR(p.month, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') THEN 'Q3'
             ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter,
        SUM((p.oil_production_mt + p.condensate_production_mt) * 7.33 * x.ongc_crude_net_realisation_inr_bbl) AS oil_val,
        SUM(p.gas_production_mmscm * x.apm_gas_price_usd_mmbtu * x.inr_usd_fx_rate) AS gas_val,
        SUM(p.total_production_boe) AS boe
    FROM production_monthly p
    JOIN price_fx_monthly x ON x.month = p.month

    GROUP BY p.asset_wc_id, quarter
),
ms AS (

        IFNULL(SAFE_DIVIDE(oil_val, SUM(oil_val) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_wc_id)), 0.25) AS oil_share,
        IFNULL(SAFE_DIVIDE(gas_val, SUM(gas_val) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_wc_id)), 0.25) AS gas_share
    FROM m
),
cl AS (
    SELECT wc_id AS asset_wc_id,
        CASE WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN 'Q1'
             WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') THEN 'Q2'
             WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') THEN 'Q3'
             ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter,
        SUM(amount_inr) AS amt
    FROM cost_ledger
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY asset_wc_id, quarter
),
cls AS (
    SELECT asset_wc_id, quarter, SAFE_DIVIDE(amt, SUM(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_wc_id)) AS opex_share FROM cl
),
a AS (

        a.cess * ms.oil_share AS cess_q,

    LEFT JOIN cls ON cls.asset_wc_id = a.asset_wc_id AND cls.quarter = ms.quarter

    ROUND(q2.boe / 1e6, 2) AS production_mmboe,
    ROUND(q2.oil_q, 1) AS crude_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gas_q, 1) AS gas_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q, 1) AS gross_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.royalty_saed_q + q2.cess_q, 1) AS statutory_levies_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q, 1) AS net_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.opex_q, 1) AS opex_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q, 1) AS ebitda_cr,
    ROUND((q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q) * 100 / NULLIF(q2.gross_q, 0), 1) AS ebitda_margin_pct,

    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q - q2.dda_q, 1) AS pbt_cr,
    ROUND(q2.ebitda_fy, 1) AS ebitda_fy26_annual_cr
FROM q2
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = q2.asset_wc_id
ORDER BY q2.ebitda_fy DESC, q2.quarter;

    ROUND(q2.gross_q, 1) AS gross_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.royalty_saed_q + q2.cess_q, 1) AS statutory_levies_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q, 1) AS net_revenue_cr,
    ROUND(q2.opex_q, 1) AS opex_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q, 1) AS ebitda_cr,
    ROUND((q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q) * 100 / NULLIF(q2.gross_q, 0), 1) AS ebitda_margin_pct,
    ROUND(q2.dda_q, 1) AS dda_cr,
    ROUND(q2.gross_q - q2.royalty_saed_q - q2.cess_q - q2.opex_q - q2.dda_q, 1) AS pbt_cr,
    ROUND(q2.ebitda_fy, 1) AS ebitda_fy26_annual_cr
FROM q2
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = q2.asset_wc_id
ORDER BY q2.ebitda_fy DESC, q2.quarter;

-- Answer Key SQL: E2
-- Question: When am I due for transfer, and what is the rotation policy for my grade?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL listed the posting only. Now applies JRTP 3.0 (rotation window 36-60 months) and 9.1 (AGT effective by 1 July) to the current posting (is_current_posting).

SELECT
    p.emp_id,
    p.wc_id,
    w.name AS work_centre,
    w.cluster_id,
    p.grade_id,
    p.from_date AS station_since,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', p.from_date, MONTH) AS tenure_months,
    DATE_ADD(p.from_date, INTERVAL 36 MONTH) AS rotation_window_opens,
    DATE_ADD(p.from_date, INTERVAL 60 MONTH) AS rotation_window_closes,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', p.from_date, MONTH) > 60 THEN 'beyond 5-year window - due in next AGT'
        WHEN DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', p.from_date, MONTH) >= 36 THEN 'within 3-5 year window - eligible'
        ELSE 'not yet eligible (under 3 years)'
    END AS rotation_status,
    DATE '2027-07-01' AS next_agt_effective_by,
    p.exemption_tag
FROM posting_history p
JOIN dim_work_centre w ON p.wc_id = w.wc_id
WHERE p.emp_id = 'EMP-102451'
  AND p.is_current_posting = TRUE;

-- Question: Which training programmes can I take this year?

WITH me AS (

    FROM employee_master
    WHERE emp_id = 'EMP-102451'
)
SELECT
    t.programme_id,
    t.programme_name,
    t.institute,
    t.location_city,
    LOWER(t.category) AS category,
    t.start_date,
    t.duration_days,
    t.prerequisite_experience_years,
    t.start_date >= DATE '2026-10-19' AS still_open,
    me.discipline_id IN UNNEST(t.eligible_disciplines) AS discipline_listed
FROM training_calendar t
CROSS JOIN me
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY27'
  AND me.grade_id IN UNNEST(t.eligible_grades)
  AND t.prerequisite_experience_years <= me.total_tenure_years

-- Answer Key SQL: P2
-- Question: Which stations count as one cluster for tenure purposes?
-- Type: policy
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old query returned the JRTP 5.0 metadata header (no cluster list) plus 4 TA-regulation
-- chunks (P1-16) irrelevant to clusters. Now lists the 13 clusters from dim_work_centre (structured) with
-- their work centres and checks each is named in JRTP Clause 5.2.

WITH doc AS (
  SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(text, r'\s+', ' ') AS body
  FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_docs.silver_chunks`
  WHERE doc_id = 'JRTP' AND clause_ref = 'Clause 5.0'
)
SELECT
    w.cluster_id,
    w.cluster_name,
    COUNT(*) AS work_centres,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT w.city, ', ' ORDER BY w.city) AS cities,
    STRING_AGG(w.short_name, '; ' ORDER BY w.wc_id) AS work_centre_names,
    LOGICAL_AND(STRPOS(doc.body, CONCAT('Cluster ', w.cluster_id, ' ')) > 0) AS listed_in_jrtp_5_2
FROM dim_work_centre w
CROSS JOIN doc
GROUP BY w.cluster_id, w.cluster_name
ORDER BY work_centres DESC, w.cluster_id;

rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Annual Accrual Rate: Regular employees shall earn 30 (thirty) calendar days of Earned Leave in each calendar year. 3.2 Advance Credit: EL shall be credited in advance in two equal installments of 15 days each on 1st January and 1st July of every calendar year. 3.3 Maximum Accumulation Ceiling: Earned Leave may be accumulated up to a strict maximum ceiling of 300 (three hundred) days.

rows.heading: Encashment of Earned Leave
rows.quote_snippet: 4.1 Encashment on Superannuation: An employee retiring on superannuation, voluntary retirement, or upon death in service shall be entitled to receive lump-sum cash equivalent of unutilized Earned Leave standing to their credit, subject to a maximum aggregate ceiling of 300 (three hundred) days. 4.2 Encashment Calculation Formula: The cash equivalent of leave salary for encashment shall be calculated strictly as: Cash Amount = [(Basic Pay on date of retirement + IDA applicable) / 30] × Number of Unutilized EL Days (up to max 300). No house rent allowance (HRA), cafeteria perks, or performance related pay (PRP) shall be included in the encashment calculation.

-- Answer Key SQL: P7
-- Question: What is my travel class and lodging allowance for official travel to Mumbai as an E2?
-- Type: policy
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: dim_grade lookup was correct but the MD rendered an empty citation. Added the
-- Mumbai city class and the E2 lodging actually reimbursed on Mumbai claims (travel_claims) as corroboration.

WITH mum AS (
  SELECT
      grade_id,
      ANY_VALUE(city_category) AS mumbai_city_category,
      COUNT(*) AS e2_mumbai_claims,
      ROUND(AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(lodging_hotel_amount_inr, DATE_DIFF(end_date, start_date, DAY)))) AS avg_lodging_per_night_inr,
      ANY_VALUE(travel_class_entitlement) AS claim_class_entitlement
  FROM travel_claims
  WHERE grade_id = 'E2' AND LOWER(to_city) = 'mumbai'
  GROUP BY grade_id
)

    g.grade_id,
    g.designation,
    g.ta_da_travel_class,
    g.daily_lodging_limit_cat_a_inr,
    m.mumbai_city_category,
    m.e2_mumbai_claims,
    m.avg_lodging_per_night_inr,
    m.claim_class_entitlement
FROM dim_grade g
LEFT JOIN mum m USING (grade_id)
WHERE g.grade_id = 'E2';

rows.heading: Time-Bound Promotion Channel (E1→E4)
rows.quote_snippet: 2.1 Qualifying Residency Requirements: Promotions within the junior executive ranks (E1 through E4) shall be governed by the Time-Bound Promotion Channel subject to completing prescribed residency and meeting the APAR benchmark: (a) Promotion from E1 to E2: 3 (three) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E1. (b) Promotion from E2 to E3: 3 (three) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E2. (c) Promotion from E3 to E4: 3 to 4 (three to four) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E3. 2.2 Non-Vacancy Based Progression: In the time-bound channel, promotions are not constrained by fixed budgetary post vacancies; all officers who complete the qualifying residency and achieve the required performance rating and vigilance clearance shall be promoted. 2.3 Effective Date of Promotion: Time-bound promotions shall take effect from 1st January or 1st July following completion of qualifying residency.

rows.heading: APAR Benchmark for Time-Bound Promotion
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Performance Benchmark Threshold: To qualify for time-bound promotion, an executive must maintain a consistent track record of satisfactory performance across the qualifying residency years: (a) For E1→E2: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Good' (score ≥ 3.0 / 60%) in the annual e-APAR ratings for the preceding 3 years. (b) For E2→E3: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Good' to 'Very Good' (score ≥ 3.5 / 70%) across the preceding 3 years, with no adverse remark. (c) For E3→E4: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Very Good' (score ≥ 3.5 / 70%) across the preceding residency period. 3.2 Adverse Remark Disqualification: Any uncommunicated or sustained adverse remark, or an APAR rating below 'Good' in any single year, shall result in deferment of promotion by one year until the benchmark is restored.

rows.heading: Vigilance Clearance as Pre-Condition
rows.quote_snippet: 7.1 Mandatory Vigilance Clearance: Clear and unconditional vigilance clearance from the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) is a non-negotiable mandatory prerequisite for placing any officer on the promotion panel or releasing promotion orders. 7.2 Disqualifying Vigilance Status: An officer shall not be granted promotion if: (a) under suspension; (b) a charge-sheet for major penalty disciplinary proceedings under CDA Rule 14 has been issued; or (c) prosecution for a criminal charge is pending.

-- Answer Key SQL: P11
-- Question: Under the transfer policy, who in Delhi has exceeded the cumulative-tenure cap, and who is exempt because they retire soon?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: JRTP Clause 1.2 applies only to regular executives E0-E9. Old SQL counted every staff member
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: currently in CL-DEL (200 Group C/D non-executives + the CMD) and labelled them "executives".
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now split by staff population via dim_grade.cadre; only the 'executive' row is in JRTP scope.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Exemption = retirement within 3 years of 2026-10-19 (Clause 7.1 practice; 2-year strict rule also shown).
WITH delhi AS (
    SELECT v.emp_id, v.cumulative_cluster_years, v.has_breached_cluster_10yr_cap, v.retirement_date, g.cadre
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_cluster_cumulative_tenure` v
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = v.current_grade_id
    WHERE v.cluster_id = 'CL-DEL' AND v.is_currently_in_cluster
)
SELECT
    CASE LOWER(cadre) WHEN 'executive' THEN 'Executives E0-E9 (JRTP scope)'
                      WHEN 'non_executive' THEN 'Non-executives Group B/C/D (outside JRTP)'
                      ELSE 'Board - CMD/Directors (outside JRTP)' END AS staff_population,
    LOWER(cadre) = 'executive' AS in_jrtp_scope,
    COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS currently_in_delhi_cluster,
    ROUND(MAX(cumulative_cluster_years), 2) AS max_cumulative_years,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(cumulative_cluster_years >= 8, emp_id, NULL)) AS approaching_cap_8yr_plus,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_breached_cluster_10yr_cap, emp_id, NULL)) AS breached_10yr_cap,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_breached_cluster_10yr_cap AND DATE_DIFF(retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 3 * 365.25, emp_id, NULL)) AS breached_exempt_retiring_3yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_breached_cluster_10yr_cap AND DATE_DIFF(retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) > 3 * 365.25, emp_id, NULL)) AS breached_due_transfer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_DIFF(retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 2 * 365.25, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_within_2yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_DIFF(retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 3 * 365.25, emp_id, NULL)) AS retiring_within_3yr
FROM delhi
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY in_jrtp_scope DESC, staff_population;

-- Answer Key SQL: P12
-- Question: Which executives are due for an E4→E5 merit review and have **not** done a North-East or hard posting?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL counted every E4->E5 DPC case since FY01 (mostly completed = already promoted) per
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: discipline. "Due" now = open (status 'delayed', not yet held) E4->E5 cases of Active executives
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: still in grade E4. Hard/NE = dim_work_centre.hard_station_cat 'C' (Assam, Jorhat, Tripura,
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Bokaro, Rajasthan, Mumbai High/Bassein/Neelam offshore, Eastern Offshore). JRTP Clause 6.1
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: requires one continuous 3-year Cat-C tenure: contiguous Cat-C postings are merged (gaps-and-islands).
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Lists every due executive who has NOT completed a continuous 3-year hard/NE tenure.
WITH due AS (
    SELECT d.emp_id, d.fiscal_year AS dpc_fiscal_year, d.due_date, d.pending_reason
    FROM dpc_cases d
    JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = d.emp_id
    WHERE d.from_grade_id = 'E4' AND d.to_grade_id = 'E5'
      AND LOWER(d.status) = 'delayed' AND d.held_date IS NULL
      AND LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active' AND e.current_grade_id = 'E4'
),
c_post AS (
    SELECT p.emp_id, p.from_date, COALESCE(p.to_date, DATE '2026-10-19') AS to_date
    FROM posting_history p
    JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = p.wc_id
    WHERE UPPER(w.hard_station_cat) = 'C' AND p.emp_id IN (SELECT emp_id FROM due)
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, IF(from_date > DATE_ADD(MAX(to_date) OVER (PARTITION BY emp_id ORDER BY from_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), INTERVAL 1 DAY), 1, 0) AS new_run
    FROM c_post
),
runs AS (
    SELECT emp_id, SUM(new_run) OVER (PARTITION BY emp_id ORDER BY from_date) AS run_id, from_date, to_date FROM flagged
),
hs AS (
    SELECT emp_id, MAX(run_days) AS longest_run_days, SUM(run_days) AS total_c_days
    FROM (SELECT emp_id, run_id, DATE_DIFF(MAX(to_date), MIN(from_date), DAY) AS run_days FROM runs GROUP BY 1, 2)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    e.emp_id,
    e.name,
    dd.name AS discipline,
    w.short_name AS current_work_centre,
    due.dpc_fiscal_year,
    due.pending_reason,
    hs.emp_id IS NULL AS never_hard_or_ne_posted,
    ROUND(COALESCE(hs.total_c_days, 0) / 365.25, 2) AS hard_ne_service_years,
    ROUND(COALESCE(hs.longest_run_days, 0) / 365.25, 2) AS longest_continuous_hard_ne_years,
    COALESCE(hs.longest_run_days, 0) AS longest_continuous_hard_ne_days
FROM due
JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = due.emp_id
LEFT JOIN dim_discipline dd ON dd.discipline_id = e.discipline_id
LEFT JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = e.current_wc_id
LEFT JOIN hs ON hs.emp_id = due.emp_id
WHERE COALESCE(hs.longest_run_days, 0) < 1095
ORDER BY never_hard_or_ne_posted DESC, longest_continuous_hard_ne_days, e.emp_id;
