-- Answer Key SQL: P13
-- Question: Are we within the DPE 30% superannuation cap on benefits? How much headroom is left?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL listed benefit_liabilities.annual_payout_inr_cr (benefits PAID to retirees) and a flag;
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: the DPE cap (PRBS Clause 3.1) is on EMPLOYER CONTRIBUTIONS as % of (Basic Pay + DA). Now computed
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: from payroll_monthly: employer CPF + PRBS + PRMB; gratuity is not in payroll, so its accrual rate is
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: imputed as superannuation_benefit_pct minus the three payroll rates (stated as an assumption).
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: FY25 and FY26 full years plus FY27 YTD (Apr-Sep, 6 months; rates comparable, crore amounts are not).
WITH p AS (
    SELECT fiscal_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months_covered,
        SUM(basic_pay_inr + da_inr) / 1e7 AS basic_da_cr,
        SUM(employer_cpf_inr) / 1e7 AS cpf_cr,
        SUM(employer_prbs_inr) / 1e7 AS prbs_cr,
        SUM(employer_prmb_inr) / 1e7 AS prmb_cr,
        SUM(superannuation_benefit_pct / 100 * (basic_pay_inr + da_inr)) / 1e7 AS total_super_cr
    FROM payroll_monthly
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY25', @fiscal_year, 'FY27')
    GROUP BY fiscal_year
)
SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    months_covered,
    ROUND(basic_da_cr, 1) AS basic_plus_da_cr,
    ROUND(100 * cpf_cr / basic_da_cr, 2) AS cpf_pct,
    ROUND(100 * prbs_cr / basic_da_cr, 2) AS prbs_pct,
    ROUND(100 * prmb_cr / basic_da_cr, 2) AS prmb_pct,
    ROUND(100 * (total_super_cr - cpf_cr - prbs_cr - prmb_cr) / basic_da_cr, 2) AS gratuity_pct_imputed,
    ROUND(100 * total_super_cr / basic_da_cr, 2) AS total_employer_super_pct,
    30.0 AS dpe_cap_pct,
    ROUND(30.0 - 100 * total_super_cr / basic_da_cr, 2) AS headroom_pct_points,
    ROUND(total_super_cr, 1) AS employer_super_contribution_cr,
    ROUND(0.30 * basic_da_cr, 1) AS cap_amount_cr,
    ROUND(0.30 * basic_da_cr - total_super_cr, 1) AS headroom_cr,
    100 * total_super_cr / basic_da_cr <= 30.0 AS within_cap
FROM p
ORDER BY fiscal_year;

-- Answer Key SQL: P14
-- Question: Our MoU rating sets the performance-related pay pool. What's the pay impact if we drop from "Excellent" to "Very Good"?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL listed MoU parameter targets only (no PRP, no rating scenario). Now applies the DPE 3rd PRC
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: PRP formula (G-01 Part 13: MoU component = 50% of PRP; eligibility Excellent 100% / Very Good 75% /
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Good 50% / Fair 25%) to the FY26 executive (E1-E9) PRP outgo in payroll_monthly, holding team (30%)
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: and individual (20%) components constant. Assumption: FY26 executive PRP outgo = the Excellent-basis pool.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: FY26 MoU composite score and FY27 projected composite are attached for context.
WITH prp AS (
    SELECT SUM(p.prp_inr) / 1e7 AS exec_prp_cr
    FROM payroll_monthly p
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = p.grade_id
    WHERE p.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(g.cadre) = 'executive'
),
mou AS (
    SELECT MAX(IF(fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, composite_score, NULL)) AS fy26_composite,
           MAX(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY27', projected_composite_score, NULL)) AS fy27_projected_composite
    FROM mou_targets
)
SELECT
    s.mou_rating,
    s.mou_eligibility_pct,
    0.5 * s.mou_eligibility_pct + 50 AS pool_factor_pct,
    ROUND(prp.exec_prp_cr * (0.5 * s.mou_eligibility_pct + 50) / 100, 1) AS exec_prp_pool_cr,
    ROUND(prp.exec_prp_cr * (0.5 * s.mou_eligibility_pct + 50) / 100 - prp.exec_prp_cr, 1) AS change_vs_excellent_cr,
    ROUND(0.5 * s.mou_eligibility_pct + 50 - 100, 1) AS change_vs_excellent_pct,
    mou.fy26_composite AS fy26_mou_composite_score,
    mou.fy27_projected_composite AS fy27_projected_composite_score
FROM prp, mou, UNNEST([
    STRUCT('Excellent' AS mou_rating, 100 AS mou_eligibility_pct),
    STRUCT('Very Good', 75),
    STRUCT('Good', 50),
    STRUCT('Fair', 25)
]) s
ORDER BY s.mou_eligibility_pct DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: P15
-- Question: Did we meet the 2% CSR obligation in FY26? Which states got the most?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL ranked states only and never tested the 2% obligation. Section 135 obligation for FY26 =
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: 2% of average net profit (PBT proxy, corporate_financials.pbt_inr_cr) of the three preceding FYs
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (FY23, FY24, FY25). Each state row carries FY26 total spend, obligation and % of obligation.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Removed the never-matching '2026' fiscal_year alternate.
WITH obligation AS (
    SELECT 0.02 * AVG(pbt_inr_cr) AS obligation_cr, AVG(pbt_inr_cr) AS avg_pbt_3yr_cr
    FROM corporate_financials
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25')
),
st AS (
    SELECT c.state_code, g.state_name, SUM(c.actual_disbursed_inr_cr) AS spend_cr, COUNT(*) AS projects
    FROM csr_projects c
    LEFT JOIN dim_geography g ON g.state_code = c.state_code
    WHERE c.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    st.state_name,
    st.state_code,
    st.projects,
    ROUND(st.spend_cr, 2) AS csr_spend_cr,
    ROUND(100 * st.spend_cr / SUM(st.spend_cr) OVER (), 1) AS share_of_fy26_spend_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(st.spend_cr) OVER (), 2) AS fy26_total_spend_cr,
    ROUND(o.avg_pbt_3yr_cr, 1) AS avg_net_profit_fy23_fy25_cr,
    ROUND(o.obligation_cr, 1) AS obligation_2pct_cr,
    ROUND(100 * SUM(st.spend_cr) OVER () / o.obligation_cr, 1) AS spend_pct_of_obligation,
    SUM(st.spend_cr) OVER () >= o.obligation_cr AS obligation_met
FROM st, obligation o
ORDER BY csr_spend_cr DESC, state_name;

-- Answer Key SQL: P16
-- Question: Who has the authority to approve a ₹50 crore drilling contract under the delegated powers?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL listed the top-50 drilling POs by value and never mapped them to an approval authority.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now maps the BDP 2015 delegation ladder (Clauses 2.1, 3.3, 4.2, 6.1) onto drilling-category PO value
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: (revised value of drilling lines per PO, rupees -> crore), so the ₹50 cr case and actual usage are both visible.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Bands are upper-inclusive ("up to ₹X Crore"): a ₹50 cr drilling award falls in the Functional Director tier.
WITH po AS (
    SELECT po_number, SUM(revised_po_value_inr) / 1e7 AS po_value_cr
    FROM purchase_orders
    WHERE LOWER(service_contract_category) LIKE '%drilling%'
    GROUP BY po_number
),
tiers AS (
    SELECT * FROM UNNEST([
        STRUCT(1 AS tier, 'Up to ₹10 cr' AS value_band, 0.0 AS lo_cr, 10.0 AS hi_cr, 'Level 3: Asset/Basin Manager, ED heading work centre (open tender, Associate Finance concurrence)' AS approving_authority, 'BDP Clause 2.1' AS bdp_clause),
        STRUCT(2, '₹10-50 cr', 10.0, 50.0, 'Functional Director (drilling/well-service award) with Director (Finance) concurrence', 'BDP Clause 3.3'),
        STRUCT(3, '₹50-100 cr', 50.0, 100.0, 'Executive Committee (CMD + all Whole-Time Directors)', 'BDP Clause 4.2'),
        STRUCT(4, 'Above ₹100 cr', 100.0, 1e9, 'Board of Directors (EC appraisal first)', 'BDP Clause 6.1(a)')
    ])
)
SELECT
    t.tier,
    t.value_band,
    t.approving_authority,
    t.bdp_clause,
    COUNT(po.po_number) AS drilling_pos,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(po.po_value_cr), 0), 1) AS drilling_po_value_cr,
    ROUND(MAX(po.po_value_cr), 2) AS largest_po_cr
FROM tiers t
LEFT JOIN po ON po.po_value_cr > t.lo_cr AND po.po_value_cr <= t.hi_cr
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY t.tier;

-- Answer Key SQL: P17
-- Question: Does our dividend policy allow a higher payout this year, given the capex plan?
-- Type: policy_plus_data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL returned only FY26 PAT/dividend/DPS and ignored the capex plan the question hinges on.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now FY26 (last full FY) payout vs DIPAM floor (30% of PAT; 5%-of-net-worth leg not computable: no
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: net worth in data), internal accruals after dividend (PAT + DD&A - dividend) vs capex, and the
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: max extra DPS = surplus / implied share count (dividend / DPS); current-year capex run-rate: FY27 Apr-Sep actual vs FY26 Apr-Sep actual (equal 6-month coverage, capex_budget).
WITH h1 AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY27', actual_spend_inr_cr, 0)) AS fy27_h1_capex_cr,
        SUM(IF(fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-09', actual_spend_inr_cr, 0)) AS fy26_h1_capex_cr,
        SUM(IF(fiscal_year = 'FY27', budget_estimate_be_inr_cr, 0)) AS fy27_h1_capex_be_cr
    FROM capex_budget
    WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY26', 'FY27')
)
SELECT
    f.fiscal_year,
    f.pat_inr_cr,
    f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr AS dividend_cr,
    f.dividend_per_share_inr,
    ROUND(100 * f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr / f.pat_inr_cr, 1) AS payout_pct_of_pat,
    ROUND(0.30 * f.pat_inr_cr, 0) AS dipam_floor_30pct_pat_cr,
    ROUND(f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr - 0.30 * f.pat_inr_cr, 0) AS paid_above_floor_cr,
    f.dda_inr_cr,
    f.total_capex_spent_inr_cr AS capex_cr,
    ROUND(f.pat_inr_cr + f.dda_inr_cr - f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr, 0) AS accruals_after_dividend_cr,
    ROUND(f.pat_inr_cr + f.dda_inr_cr - f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr - f.total_capex_spent_inr_cr, 0) AS surplus_after_capex_cr,
    ROUND((f.pat_inr_cr + f.dda_inr_cr - f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr - f.total_capex_spent_inr_cr)
          / (f.total_dividend_payout_inr_cr / f.dividend_per_share_inr), 2) AS max_extra_dps_from_surplus_inr,
    ROUND(h1.fy26_h1_capex_cr, 0) AS fy26_apr_sep_capex_cr,
    ROUND(h1.fy27_h1_capex_cr, 0) AS fy27_apr_sep_capex_cr,
    ROUND(h1.fy27_h1_capex_be_cr, 0) AS fy27_apr_sep_capex_be_cr,
    ROUND(100 * (h1.fy27_h1_capex_cr - h1.fy26_h1_capex_cr) / h1.fy26_h1_capex_cr, 1) AS capex_h1_change_pct
FROM corporate_financials f, h1
WHERE f.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year;

-- Answer Key SQL: T1
-- Question: "Which fields lost money in FY26?" → "Why is Field X losing?" → "How many people work there, and what do they cost?" → "Draft a board note with options."
-- Type: chain
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Result unchanged (only Champang lost money at PBT level in FY26; no field had negative EBITDA). Added line_type='field' filter (LOWER), dropped dead '2026' code, added context columns (maturity, lifting cost, root cause, fields evaluated).

SELECT
    pnl.field_id,
    f.name AS field_name,
    f.onshore_offshore,
    f.maturity,
    pnl.asset_wc_id,
    pnl.fiscal_year,
    pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    pnl.total_opex_inr_cr,
    pnl.ebitda_inr_cr,
    pnl.dda_depreciation_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr,
    pnl.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd,
    pnl.root_cause_loss_code,
    pnl.is_loss_making_3yr_consecutive,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_pnl_annual x WHERE x.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(x.line_type) = 'field') AS fields_evaluated
FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
JOIN dim_field f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
  AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
  AND (pnl.pbt_inr_cr < 0 OR pnl.ebitda_inr_cr < 0)
ORDER BY pnl.pbt_inr_cr ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: T1
-- Question: "Which fields lost money in FY26?" → "Why is Field X losing?" → "How many people work there, and what do they cost?" → "Draft a board note with options."
-- Type: chain
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Result unchanged (only Champang lost money at PBT level in FY26; no field had negative EBITDA). Added line_type='field' filter (LOWER), dropped dead '2026' code, added context columns (maturity, lifting cost, root cause, fields evaluated).

SELECT
    pnl.field_id,
    f.name AS field_name,
    f.onshore_offshore,
    f.maturity,
    pnl.asset_wc_id,
    pnl.fiscal_year,
    pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    pnl.total_opex_inr_cr,
    pnl.ebitda_inr_cr,
    pnl.dda_depreciation_inr_cr,
    pnl.pbt_inr_cr,
    pnl.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd,
    pnl.root_cause_loss_code,
    pnl.is_loss_making_3yr_consecutive,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_pnl_annual x WHERE x.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(x.line_type) = 'field') AS fields_evaluated
FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
JOIN dim_field f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
  AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
  AND (pnl.pbt_inr_cr < 0 OR pnl.ebitda_inr_cr < 0)
ORDER BY pnl.pbt_inr_cr ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: T2
-- Question: "Who in Delhi has 5+ years?" → "Which of them breach the transfer policy?" → "Match them to vacancies at hard stations." → "Export as an Excel transfer proposal."
-- Type: chain
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL truncated the list at LIMIT 100 (419 qualify); its COALESCE(exemption_tag,'Impending_Retirement') was intended to impute exemptions (silver stores the literal string 'None', so it showed 'None').
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: all executives currently in Delhi HQ with >= 5 years continuous stay (v_continuous_stay, consistent with C1), exemption tag with 'None' mapped to NULL, and 3-year pre-retirement flag.

SELECT
    v.emp_id,
    v.grade_id,
    v.discipline_id,
    d.name AS discipline_name,
    v.continuous_from_date,
    ROUND(v.continuous_stay_months / 12.0, 1) AS delhi_years,
    v.retirement_date,
    DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) <= 3 * 365.25 AS within_3yr_of_superannuation,
    NULLIF(p.exemption_tag, 'None') AS exemption_tag
FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
JOIN dim_discipline d ON d.discipline_id = v.discipline_id
LEFT JOIN posting_history p ON p.emp_id = v.emp_id AND p.is_current_posting AND p.wc_id = @wc_id
WHERE v.is_current_stay AND v.wc_id = 'WC-DEL' AND v.grade_id LIKE 'E%' AND v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months
ORDER BY delhi_years DESC, v.emp_id;

-- Answer Key SQL: T3
-- Question: "Which GMs retire in 2027?" → "Who is ready to succeed each?" → "Which successors haven't served in the North East?"
-- Type: chain
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL was not restricted to GMs (included the CMD and a CGM), used a 19-Oct-2026..Dec-2027 window, and only saw GMs who already have a succession_plan row (4 of 12).
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: every active GM (E7) retiring in calendar 2027 from employee_master, LEFT JOINed to succession_plan (successor, readiness, NE flag, no-plan flag).

SELECT
    e.emp_id AS gm_emp_id,
    e.current_designation,
    e.current_wc_id,
    e.discipline_id,
    e.retirement_date,
    sp.position_id,
    sp.criticality_tier,
    sp.successor_1_emp_id,
    sp.successor_1_readiness,
    sp.successor_1_has_ne_hard_station,
    sp.position_id IS NULL AS no_succession_plan
FROM employee_master e
LEFT JOIN succession_plan sp ON sp.incumbent_emp_id = e.emp_id
WHERE LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
  AND e.current_grade_id = 'E7'
  AND e.retirement_date BETWEEN DATE '2027-01-01' AND DATE '2027-12-31'
ORDER BY e.retirement_date, e.emp_id;

sources.sql:
-- Answer Key SQL: W1
-- Question: If Brent falls to $60/bbl, which fields go into loss?
-- Type: what_if

WITH price_params AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(brent_usd_bbl) AS avg_brent,
        AVG(ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl) AS avg_realisation,
        AVG(brent_usd_bbl - ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl) AS avg_discount
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.price_fx_monthly`
    WHERE fiscal_year IN (@fiscal_year, '2026')
),
sim_brent60 AS (
    SELECT
        pnl.field_id,
        f.name AS field_name,
        f.onshore_offshore,
        pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr AS base_revenue_cr,
        pnl.total_opex_inr_cr AS base_opex_cr,
        pnl.dda_depreciation_inr_cr AS base_dda_cr,
        (pnl.oil_revenue_inr_cr * ((60.0 - params.avg_discount) / params.avg_realisation) + pnl.gas_revenue_inr_cr) AS sim_gross_rev_cr,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(pnl.statutory_royalty_inr_cr, NULLIF(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr, 0)) AS eff_royalty_rate,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(pnl.statutory_cess_inr_cr, NULLIF(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr, 0)) AS eff_cess_rate
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.field_pnl_annual` pnl
    JOIN `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.dim_field` f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
    CROSS JOIN price_params params
    WHERE pnl.fiscal_year IN (@fiscal_year, '2026') AND pnl.line_type = 'field'
)
SELECT
    field_id,
    field_name,
    onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr, 2) AS sim_gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    ROUND(base_opex_cr, 2) AS total_opex_inr_cr,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr, 2) AS sim_ebitda_inr_cr,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr - base_dda_cr, 2) AS sim_pbt_inr_cr,
    CASE WHEN (sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr) < 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_ebitda_negative,
    CASE WHEN (sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr - base_dda_cr) < 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_pbt_negative
FROM sim_brent60
ORDER BY sim_pbt_inr_cr ASC;

        AVG(brent_usd_bbl - ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl) AS avg_discount
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.price_fx_monthly`
    WHERE fiscal_year IN (@fiscal_year, '2026')
),
sim_brent60 AS (
    SELECT
        pnl.field_id,
        f.name AS field_name,
        f.onshore_offshore,
        pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr AS base_revenue_cr,
        pnl.total_opex_inr_cr AS base_opex_cr,
        pnl.dda_depreciation_inr_cr AS base_dda_cr,
        (pnl.oil_revenue_inr_cr * ((60.0 - params.avg_discount) / params.avg_realisation) + pnl.gas_revenue_inr_cr) AS sim_gross_rev_cr,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(pnl.statutory_royalty_inr_cr, NULLIF(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr, 0)) AS eff_royalty_rate,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(pnl.statutory_cess_inr_cr, NULLIF(pnl.gross_revenue_inr_cr, 0)) AS eff_cess_rate
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.field_pnl_annual` pnl
    JOIN `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_silver.dim_field` f ON pnl.field_id = f.field_id
    CROSS JOIN price_params params
    WHERE pnl.fiscal_year IN (@fiscal_year, '2026') AND pnl.line_type = 'field'
)
SELECT
    field_id,
    field_name,
    onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr, 2) AS sim_gross_revenue_inr_cr,
    ROUND(base_opex_cr, 2) AS total_opex_inr_cr,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr, 2) AS sim_ebitda_inr_cr,
    ROUND(sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr - base_dda_cr, 2) AS sim_pbt_inr_cr,
    CASE WHEN (sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr) < 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_ebitda_negative,
    CASE WHEN (sim_gross_rev_cr * (1.0 - eff_royalty_rate - eff_cess_rate) - base_opex_cr - base_dda_cr) < 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_pbt_negative
FROM sim_brent60
ORDER BY sim_pbt_inr_cr ASC;

-- Answer Key SQL: W2
-- Question: If we freeze hiring for 2 years, what will headcount be by discipline in 2028, given retirements?
-- Type: what_if
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL restricted 'headcount' to executives only (13,453 of 22,798), silently dropping 9,345 non-executives from discipline headcounts.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: whole active workforce by discipline (executives shown separately), retirements 20-Oct-2026..19-Oct-2028, projected headcount under a 2-year hiring freeze (retirement-only attrition).

SELECT
    d.discipline_id,
    d.name AS discipline_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS current_headcount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.current_grade_id LIKE 'E%', e.emp_id, NULL)) AS current_executives,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.retirement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-20' AND DATE '2028-10-19', e.emp_id, NULL)) AS retirements_by_oct2028,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.retirement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-20' AND DATE '2028-10-19', e.emp_id, NULL)) AS projected_headcount_oct2028,
    ROUND(-COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.retirement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-20' AND DATE '2028-10-19', e.emp_id, NULL)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id), 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM employee_master e
JOIN dim_discipline d ON e.discipline_id = d.discipline_id
WHERE LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
GROUP BY d.discipline_id, d.name
ORDER BY current_headcount DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: W3
-- Question: If we move 200 executives from Delhi/Dehradun to field assets, what happens to transfer-grant cost and asset coverage?
-- Type: what_if
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL hard-coded 200 officers and Rs 6.50 cr, summed vacancies across all cadres (incl. non-executive) for 4 hand-picked work centres (Assam actually has 0 executive vacancies).
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: 200 movers allocated pro-rata to FY26 executive vacancies across the 14 operating assets; coverage before/after; cost at the FY26 average cost per transfer from posting_history; movable Delhi+Dehradun pool for feasibility.

WITH vac AS (
    SELECT w.wc_id, w.short_name, w.hard_station_cat,
           SUM(s.sanctioned_strength) AS sanc, SUM(s.in_position_strength) AS inpos, SUM(s.vacancy_count) AS vacancies
    FROM dim_work_centre w
    JOIN sanctioned_posts s ON s.wc_id = w.wc_id
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(s.grade_band) != 'non_executive' AND LOWER(w.type) = 'asset'
    GROUP BY w.wc_id, w.short_name, w.hard_station_cat
),
cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_transfer_cost_inr) AS avg_cost
    FROM posting_history
    WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(posting_type) IN ('rotation', 'hard_station')
),
pool AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.emp_id) AS movable_pool
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
    WHERE v.is_current_stay AND v.wc_id IN ( @wc_id, 'WC-DDN') AND v.grade_id LIKE 'E%'
      AND v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months
      AND DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) > 3 * 365.25
),
a1 AS (
    SELECT *, 200.0 * vacancies / SUM(vacancies) OVER () AS raw_alloc FROM vac
),
a2 AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(FLOOR(raw_alloc) AS INT64) AS base_alloc, raw_alloc - FLOOR(raw_alloc) AS frac FROM a1
),
a3 AS (
    SELECT *,
           base_alloc + IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY frac DESC, vacancies DESC) <= 200 - SUM(base_alloc) OVER (), 1, 0) AS allocated
    FROM a2
)
SELECT
    a3.short_name AS field_asset,
    a3.hard_station_cat,
    a3.sanc AS exec_sanctioned,
    a3.inpos AS exec_in_position,
    a3.vacancies AS exec_vacancies,
    ROUND(a3.inpos * 100.0 / a3.sanc, 1) AS coverage_pct_now,
    LEAST(a3.allocated, a3.vacancies) AS officers_allocated,
    ROUND((a3.inpos + LEAST(a3.allocated, a3.vacancies)) * 100.0 / a3.sanc, 1) AS coverage_pct_after,
    a3.vacancies - LEAST(a3.allocated, a3.vacancies) AS vacancies_after,
    ROUND(LEAST(a3.allocated, a3.vacancies) * cost.avg_cost / 1e7, 2) AS transfer_cost_inr_cr,
    ROUND(cost.avg_cost, 0) AS avg_cost_per_transfer_inr,
    pool.movable_pool AS delhi_ddn_movable_pool
FROM a3
CROSS JOIN cost
CROSS JOIN pool
ORDER BY exec_vacancies DESC, field_asset;

-- Answer Key SQL: W4
-- Question: If the windfall tax is removed, how much does net realisation per barrel improve?
-- Type: what_if
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL averaged SAED over all 12 months of each FY (incl. months with no levy), diluting the per-barrel uplift (FY23 12.15 vs 16.20 $/bbl when levied; FY25 3.27 vs 4.91).
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: per FY, months levied, average SAED $/bbl and Rs/bbl in levied months, last levied rate, FY-average, Brent, realisation and SAED paid (corporate_financials).

SELECT
    p.fiscal_year,
    COUNTIF(p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl > 0) AS months_saed_levied,
    ROUND(AVG(IF(p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl > 0, p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl, NULL)), 2) AS avg_saed_usd_bbl_when_levied,
    ROUND(AVG(IF(p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl > 0, p.windfall_tax_saed_inr_bbl, NULL)), 2) AS avg_saed_inr_bbl_when_levied,
    ARRAY_AGG(IF(p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl > 0, p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl, NULL) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY p.month DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_levied_saed_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(p.windfall_tax_saed_usd_bbl), 2) AS fy_avg_saed_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(p.brent_usd_bbl), 2) AS avg_brent_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(p.ongc_crude_net_realisation_usd_bbl), 2) AS avg_net_realisation_usd_bbl,
    ROUND(AVG(p.inr_usd_fx_rate), 2) AS avg_fx_rate,
    ANY_VALUE(c.saed_windfall_tax_inr_cr) AS saed_paid_inr_cr
FROM price_fx_monthly p
LEFT JOIN corporate_financials c ON c.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year
WHERE p.fiscal_year IN ('FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', @fiscal_year)
GROUP BY p.fiscal_year
ORDER BY p.fiscal_year;

-- Answer Key SQL: M1
-- Question: "What is the total headcount by asset?" (aggregate, non-identifying)
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL summed 12 monthly headcount snapshots for FY26 vs 1 for FY21 (Eastern Offshore '12,312', +1,182%) for 4 hand-picked assets and answered a growth question.
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Now: headcount by asset at the latest snapshot (30-Sep-2026) for all 14 operating assets, with 31-Mar-2026 and share of company.

WITH hc AS (
    SELECT
        h.wc_id,
        SUM(IF(h.month = '2026-09', h.headcount, 0)) AS hc_sep26,
        SUM(IF(h.month = '2026-03', h.headcount, 0)) AS hc_mar26
    FROM headcount_snapshot h
    WHERE h.month IN ('2026-03', '2026-09')
    GROUP BY h.wc_id
),
company AS (
    SELECT SUM(headcount) AS company_hc_sep26
    FROM headcount_snapshot
    WHERE month = '2026-09'
)
SELECT
    wc.wc_id,
    wc.short_name AS asset,
    wc.sector,
    wc.onshore_offshore,
    hc.hc_sep26 AS headcount_30sep2026,
    hc.hc_mar26 AS headcount_31mar2026,
    ROUND(hc.hc_sep26 * 100.0 / c.company_hc_sep26, 1) AS pct_of_company,
    c.company_hc_sep26
FROM dim_work_centre wc
JOIN hc ON hc.wc_id = wc.wc_id
CROSS JOIN company c
WHERE LOWER(wc.type) = 'asset'
ORDER BY headcount_30sep2026 DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: M5
-- Question: CMD: "Who tried to access confidential data this week?"
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Old SQL had no date window (all 91 days of log) despite 'this week'.

SELECT

    a.user_grade,

    a.requested_resource,

-- Answer Key SQL: X1
-- Question: How many contract workers vs. regular employees per asset, and at what cost per BOE?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Per producing asset: contract workers vs regular employees at 31-Mar-2026 (single month, not SUM of 12
-- monthly snapshots), FY26 contractor cost and regular manpower cost per BOE computed from cost / FY26 BOE (USD at FY26 avg FX).
-- Old SQL summed 12 monthly stocks (Ahmedabad 16,579 contractors vs 1,345 real), summed 12 headcount snapshots, used the
-- unreliable contractor_cost_per_boe_usd column (0 for producing Assam) and listed 46 non-producing work centres.
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT AVG(inr_usd_fx_rate) AS fx FROM price_fx_monthly WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
),
prod AS (
    SELECT asset_wc_id AS wc_id, SUM(total_production_boe) AS boe_fy26
    FROM production_monthly WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year GROUP BY asset_wc_id
),
cw_mar AS (
    SELECT wc_id, SUM(contractor_headcount) AS contract_workers_mar26
    FROM contract_workforce WHERE month = '2026-03' GROUP BY wc_id
),
cw_cost AS (
    SELECT wc_id, SUM(monthly_cost_inr) / 1e7 AS contractor_cost_fy26_cr
    FROM contract_workforce WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year GROUP BY wc_id
),
reg AS (
    SELECT wc_id, SUM(headcount) AS regular_employees_mar26
    FROM headcount_snapshot WHERE month = '2026-03' GROUP BY wc_id
),
mp AS (
    SELECT asset_wc_id AS wc_id, SUM(allocated_manpower_cost_inr_cr) AS regular_manpower_cost_fy26_cr
    FROM field_pnl_annual WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(line_type) = 'field' GROUP BY asset_wc_id
)
SELECT
    w.short_name,
    w.onshore_offshore,
    cw_mar.contract_workers_mar26,
    reg.regular_employees_mar26,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cw_mar.contract_workers_mar26, reg.regular_employees_mar26), 2) AS contract_to_regular_ratio,
    ROUND(cw_cost.contractor_cost_fy26_cr, 1) AS contractor_cost_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(mp.regular_manpower_cost_fy26_cr, 1) AS regular_manpower_cost_fy26_cr,
    ROUND(prod.boe_fy26 / 1e6, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    ROUND(cw_cost.contractor_cost_fy26_cr * 1e7 / fx.fx / prod.boe_fy26, 3) AS contractor_cost_per_boe_usd,
    ROUND(mp.regular_manpower_cost_fy26_cr * 1e7 / fx.fx / prod.boe_fy26, 2) AS regular_cost_per_boe_usd
FROM prod
CROSS JOIN fx
JOIN dim_work_centre w ON w.wc_id = prod.wc_id
LEFT JOIN cw_mar ON cw_mar.wc_id = prod.wc_id
LEFT JOIN cw_cost ON cw_cost.wc_id = prod.wc_id
LEFT JOIN reg ON reg.wc_id = prod.wc_id
LEFT JOIN mp ON mp.wc_id = prod.wc_id
ORDER BY cw_mar.contract_workers_mar26 DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: X2
-- Question: Which assets rely most on contract labour for core operations?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Core-activity work centres ranked by contract dependency at the latest month (Sep-2026): contractor
-- headcount / regular headcount. Old SQL summed 66 monthly stocks (FY22-FY27, e.g. Bassein 182,761 'contractors')
-- and sorted alphabetically instead of by reliance.
WITH cw AS (
    SELECT wc_id, SUM(contractor_headcount) AS contract_workers, LOGICAL_OR(is_core_activity) AS is_core
    FROM contract_workforce WHERE month = '2026-09' GROUP BY wc_id
),
hs AS (
    SELECT wc_id, SUM(headcount) AS regular_employees
    FROM headcount_snapshot WHERE month = '2026-09' GROUP BY wc_id
)
SELECT
    w.short_name,
    w.type AS wc_type,
    w.onshore_offshore,
    cw.contract_workers AS contract_workers_sep26,
    hs.regular_employees AS regular_employees_sep26,
    ROUND(cw.contract_workers / hs.regular_employees, 2) AS contract_to_regular_ratio,
    ROUND(cw.contract_workers * 100 / (cw.contract_workers + hs.regular_employees), 1) AS contract_share_of_workforce_pct
FROM cw JOIN hs USING (wc_id) JOIN dim_work_centre w USING (wc_id)
WHERE cw.is_core
ORDER BY contract_to_regular_ratio DESC, contract_workers_sep26 DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: X3
-- Question: Do assets with higher offshore overtime show a higher lost-time injury rate?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Answers the yes/no directly: pooled LTIFR (LTIs x 1e6 / man-hours) for the high-overtime (54 h/month,
-- offshore) vs standard (36 h) bands, FY26 and FY22-FY26 (5 full years, equal coverage). Old SQL listed 46 work centres
-- with an average of monthly LTIFRs and never compared the bands.
SELECT
    CASE WHEN h.monthly_overtime_hours_per_worker >= 50 THEN 'High overtime (54 h/month, offshore)' ELSE 'Standard overtime (36 h/month)' END AS overtime_band,
    MAX(h.monthly_overtime_hours_per_worker) AS overtime_hours_per_worker_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT h.wc_id) AS work_centres,
    COUNTIF(h.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND h.lost_time_injury_flag) AS ltis_fy26,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(h.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, h.total_manhours_worked, 0)) / 1e6, 2) AS million_manhours_fy26,
    ROUND(COUNTIF(h.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND h.lost_time_injury_flag) * 1e6 / SUM(IF(h.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year, h.total_manhours_worked, 0)), 3) AS ltifr_fy26,
    COUNTIF(h.lost_time_injury_flag) AS ltis_fy22_fy26,
    ROUND(SUM(h.total_manhours_worked) / 1e6, 2) AS million_manhours_fy22_fy26,
    ROUND(COUNTIF(h.lost_time_injury_flag) * 1e6 / SUM(h.total_manhours_worked), 3) AS ltifr_fy22_fy26,
    COUNTIF(h.lost_time_injury_flag AND h.fatigue_factor_flag) AS fatigue_linked_ltis_fy22_fy26
FROM hse_incidents h
WHERE h.fiscal_year IN ('FY22', 'FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26')
GROUP BY overtime_band
ORDER BY overtime_hours_per_worker_month DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: X4
-- Question: What is our pension and post-retirement medical liability, and its 5-year trend?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Adds the 5-year trend the question asks for (old SQL returned FY26 only, and mixed in PF and gratuity).
-- One row per FY (FY22-FY26; FY21 not in benefit_liabilities) with PRBS pension and PRMB medical obligations,
-- plan assets and net unfunded. Balances are taken per FY, never summed across years.
SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(IF(LOWER(scheme_type) = 'prbs pension', actuarial_liability_inr_cr, 0)) AS prbs_pension_liability_cr,
    SUM(IF(LOWER(scheme_type) = 'post-retirement medical', actuarial_liability_inr_cr, 0)) AS prmb_medical_liability_cr,
    SUM(actuarial_liability_inr_cr) AS combined_liability_cr,
    SUM(plan_assets_inr_cr) AS combined_plan_assets_cr,
    SUM(net_liability_inr_cr) AS combined_net_unfunded_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(plan_assets_inr_cr) * 100 / SUM(actuarial_liability_inr_cr), 1) AS combined_funded_pct
FROM benefit_liabilities
WHERE LOWER(scheme_type) IN ('prbs pension', 'post-retirement medical')
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;

-- Answer Key SQL: X5
-- Question: How did ONGC Videsh, MRPL and HPCL contribute to group profit and dividend?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Restricted to the three entities asked (old SQL included OTPC and OPAL) and adds the contribution metrics:
-- ONGC-attributable PAT (PAT x equity holding), its share of FY26 consolidated PAT, and dividend received as a share of
-- ONGC standalone PAT.
SELECT
    s.entity_code,
    s.entity_name,
    s.ongc_equity_holding_pct,
    s.pat_inr_cr AS pat_cr,
    ROUND(s.pat_inr_cr * s.ongc_equity_holding_pct / 100, 1) AS ongc_share_of_pat_cr,
    ROUND(s.pat_inr_cr * s.ongc_equity_holding_pct / c.consolidated_pat_inr_cr, 1) AS share_of_group_pat_pct,
    s.dividend_received_by_ongc_inr_cr AS dividend_received_by_ongc_cr,

-- Answer Key SQL: X6
-- Question: How much capex went to ONGC Green / renewables vs. the Net Zero 2038 path, and how many people have been reskilled?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Answers all three parts: green capex per FY (FY22-FY26) with running cumulative (sum of annual_capex -
-- the stored cumulative_capex column does not reconcile), share of company capex, MW installed, roadmap milestone
-- flag, and distinct employees completing renewable reskilling (counted once, at first completion). Old SQL showed FY26 by technology only, no reskilling.
-- GAP: no Net Zero 2038 spend trajectory exists in the data; only a boolean milestone flag.
WITH g AS (
    SELECT fiscal_year,
        SUM(annual_capex_inr_cr) AS green_capex_cr,
        SUM(installed_capacity_mw) AS installed_mw,
        LOGICAL_AND(net_zero_2038_roadmap_milestone_met) AS all_roadmap_milestones_met
    FROM energy_transition
    GROUP BY fiscal_year
),
first_completion AS (
    SELECT emp_id, MIN(fiscal_year) AS first_fy
    FROM training_records
    WHERE is_renewable_reskilling AND LOWER(completion_status) = 'completed'
    GROUP BY emp_id
),
r AS (
    SELECT first_fy AS fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS employees_newly_reskilled
    FROM first_completion
    GROUP BY first_fy
)
SELECT
    g.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(g.green_capex_cr, 1) AS green_capex_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(g.green_capex_cr) OVER (ORDER BY g.fiscal_year), 1) AS cumulative_green_capex_cr,
    c.total_capex_spent_inr_cr AS company_capex_cr,
    ROUND(g.green_capex_cr * 100 / c.total_capex_spent_inr_cr, 1) AS green_share_of_capex_pct,
    g.installed_mw,
    g.all_roadmap_milestones_met,
    r.employees_newly_reskilled,
    SUM(r.employees_newly_reskilled) OVER (ORDER BY g.fiscal_year) AS cumulative_distinct_employees_reskilled
FROM g
JOIN corporate_financials c ON c.fiscal_year = g.fiscal_year
LEFT JOIN r ON r.fiscal_year = g.fiscal_year
ORDER BY g.fiscal_year;

-- Answer Key SQL: X7
-- Question: Draft a reply to a Parliament question: "Vacancies in ONGC in the North-East region, category-wise."
-- Type: document
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Category-wise as the Parliament question asks (old SQL was work-centre-wise with no category split).
-- All six NE work centres (Assam + Tripura), FY26 sanctioned-posts roster, by social category with state split.
SELECT
    sp.social_category AS category,
    SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength) AS sanctioned,
    SUM(sp.in_position_strength) AS in_position,
    SUM(sp.vacancy_count) AS vacancies,
    SUM(IF(wc.state = 'Assam', sp.vacancy_count, 0)) AS vacancies_assam,
    SUM(IF(wc.state = 'Tripura', sp.vacancy_count, 0)) AS vacancies_tripura,
    ROUND(SUM(sp.vacancy_count) * 100 / SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength), 1) AS vacancy_rate_pct,
    SUM(sp.backlog_vacancies) AS backlog_reserved_vacancies
FROM sanctioned_posts sp
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON sp.wc_id = wc.wc_id
WHERE wc.sector = 'NE' AND sp.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
GROUP BY sp.social_category
ORDER BY CASE sp.social_category WHEN 'SC' THEN 1 WHEN 'ST' THEN 2 WHEN 'OBC' THEN 3 WHEN 'EWS' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;

-- Answer Key SQL: X8
-- Question: How many audit (CAG) objections and right-to-information (RTI) applications are pending, and how old are they?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Adds the ageing the question asks for (old SQL returned two counts only). Open CAG paras (status <> closed)
-- by age band from notification date and pending RTI applications by days since receipt, both as of 2026-10-19.
WITH cag AS (
    SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', notification_date, DAY) AS age_days, financial_implication_inr_cr
    FROM cag_paras
    WHERE LOWER(current_status) != 'closed'
),
rti AS (
    SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', received_date, DAY) AS age_days
    FROM rti_applications
    WHERE LOWER(status) LIKE 'pending%'
)
SELECT 'CAG audit paras (open)' AS item,
    CASE WHEN age_days < 365 THEN '1: under 1 year' WHEN age_days < 3 * 365 THEN '2: 1-3 years'
         WHEN age_days < 5 * 365 THEN '3: 3-5 years' ELSE '4: over 5 years' END AS age_band,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_count,
    ROUND(AVG(age_days) / 365.25, 1) AS avg_age_years,
    MAX(age_days) AS oldest_days,
    ROUND(SUM(financial_implication_inr_cr), 1) AS financial_implication_cr
FROM cag GROUP BY age_band
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RTI applications (pending)',
    CASE WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN '1: within 30 days' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '2: 31-90 days'
         WHEN age_days <= 365 THEN '3: 91-365 days' ELSE '4: over 1 year' END,
    COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(age_days) / 365.25, 1), MAX(age_days), NULL
FROM rti GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY item, age_band;

-- Answer Key SQL: X9
-- Question: CSR spend by state and theme vs. the policy's priority areas
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Adds the policy-priority dimension (CSR Policy 2025 cl.1.1: preference to Operational Areas; aspirational

SELECT
    g.state_name,
    c.csr_theme,
    COUNT(*) AS projects,
    ROUND(SUM(c.actual_disbursed_inr_cr), 2) AS spend_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(c.is_operational_field_area, c.actual_disbursed_inr_cr, 0)), 2) AS operational_area_spend_cr,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(c.is_aspirational_district, c.actual_disbursed_inr_cr, 0)), 2) AS aspirational_district_spend_cr,
    g.ongc_operational_presence AS state_has_ongc_operations
FROM csr_projects c
JOIN dim_geography g ON c.state_code = g.state_code
WHERE c.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
GROUP BY g.state_name, c.csr_theme, g.ongc_operational_presence
ORDER BY spend_cr DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: X10
-- Question: *Unprompted:* "3 projects slipped this week; 42 rotation cases overdue; Field X lifting cost up 12%."
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: Each alert component is now computed from its proper source: (1) open capital projects behind schedule
-- (project grain, not milestone rows); (2) executives past the JRTP cl.3.2 5-year rotation window at their current
-- station per hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay (>=60 months), excluding valid exemption tags and officers within 3 years of
-- superannuation (same rule as C1/H10) (old: anyone incl. non-executives with >=36 months -> 20,488); (3) largest field-level YoY change in
-- lifting cost FY26 vs FY25 on line_type='field' (old: AVG over all line types and years = 68,922,047 USD/BOE).
-- GAP: no weekly project or cost data exists, so 'this week' cannot be evaluated.
WITH proj AS (
    SELECT p.prj_id, d.name AS project_name, d.status AS project_status,
        MAX(p.schedule_slippage_months) AS slippage_months,
        MAX(p.scheduled_completion_date) AS scheduled_completion,
        MAX(p.anticipated_or_actual_completion_date) AS anticipated_completion,
        MAX(p.cost_overrun_inr_cr) AS cost_overrun_cr,
        ANY_VALUE(p.delay_root_cause_category) AS delay_root_cause,
        COUNTIF(LOWER(p.milestone_status) = 'delayed_critical_path') AS critical_path_milestones_delayed
    FROM project_progress p
    JOIN dim_project d ON d.prj_id = p.prj_id
    WHERE p.schedule_slippage_months > 0
    GROUP BY p.prj_id, d.name, d.status
),
exempt AS (
    SELECT emp_id
    FROM posting_history
    WHERE is_current_posting AND NULLIF(exemption_tag, 'None') IS NOT NULL
      AND (exemption_valid_until IS NULL OR exemption_valid_until >= DATE '2026-10-19')
),
overdue AS (
    SELECT v.emp_id, v.wc_id, v.grade_id, v.continuous_stay_months AS months_at_station
    FROM `ongc-hr-finance-agent.hrfin_gold.v_continuous_stay` v
    WHERE v.is_current_stay AND STARTS_WITH(v.grade_id, 'E') AND v.continuous_stay_months >= @min_stay_months
      AND v.emp_id NOT IN (SELECT emp_id FROM exempt)
      AND DATE_DIFF(v.retirement_date, DATE '2026-10-19', DAY) > 3 * 365.25
),
f AS (
    SELECT field_id, fiscal_year, lifting_cost_per_boe_usd, total_production_boe
    FROM field_pnl_annual
    WHERE LOWER(line_type) = 'field' AND fiscal_year IN ('FY25', 'FY26')
),
lift AS (
    SELECT a.field_id, d.name AS field_name, a.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd AS lifting_fy25_usd_boe,
        b.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd AS lifting_fy26_usd_boe,
        ROUND((b.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd - a.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd) * 100 / a.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd, 1) AS lifting_change_pct
    FROM f a
    JOIN f b ON a.field_id = b.field_id AND a.fiscal_year = 'FY25' AND b.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
    LEFT JOIN dim_field d ON d.field_id = a.field_id
)
SELECT '1: Capital projects behind schedule (open)' AS indicator,
    CAST(COUNTIF(LOWER(project_status) != 'completed') AS FLOAT64) AS value,
    CONCAT('max slippage ', CAST(MAX(IF(LOWER(project_status) != 'completed', slippage_months, NULL)) AS STRING), ' months; ',
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), ' projects incl. completed ones with slippage') AS detail
FROM proj
UNION ALL
SELECT '2: Executives overdue for rotation (>=5 yrs at station, non-exempt, >3 yrs to retirement)',
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT64),
    CONCAT('of ', CAST((SELECT COUNTIF(is_current_posting AND STARTS_WITH(grade_id, 'E')) FROM posting_history) AS STRING),
           ' executives in current postings; median ', CAST(APPROX_QUANTILES(months_at_station, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS STRING), ' months at station')
FROM overdue
UNION ALL
SELECT '3: Largest field lifting-cost increase FY26 vs FY25 (%)',
    MAX(lifting_change_pct),
    CONCAT(ARRAY_AGG(field_name ORDER BY lifting_change_pct DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)], '; fields up >=12%: ',
           CAST(COUNTIF(lifting_change_pct >= 12) AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING))
FROM lift
ORDER BY indicator;

-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: aligned with H10/X10 rotation rule. Due = current continuous stay >= 60 months at

WITH cur_exempt AS (
    SELECT emp_id, LOGICAL_OR(

base AS (

-- Answer Key SQL: C12
-- Question: What is the manpower cost per barrel of oil equivalent (BOE), by asset?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL computed manpower cost as a % of revenue (not per BOE), at field grain
-- labelled with the asset name (59 rows incl. plant/corporate P&L lines, the same asset repeated). Now: FY26,
-- field P&L lines aggregated to producing asset - allocated manpower cost x 1e7 / total BOE (ratio of sums,
-- MET-FIN-009 pattern) in INR and in USD at the FY26 average INR/USD from dim_price_fx, with headcount and
-- BOE per employee; plus a company line over all producing assets.

WITH a AS (
    SELECT pnl.asset_wc_id,
           SUM(pnl.allocated_manpower_cost_inr_cr) AS manpower_cr,
           SUM(pnl.total_production_boe) AS boe,
           SUM(pnl.regular_employee_headcount) AS regular_headcount
    FROM field_pnl_annual pnl
    WHERE pnl.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year AND LOWER(pnl.line_type) = 'field'
    GROUP BY pnl.asset_wc_id
),
fx AS (SELECT AVG(inr_usd_fx_rate) AS fx FROM dim_price_fx WHERE fiscal_year = @fiscal_year),
u AS (
    SELECT wc.short_name AS asset, wc.onshore_offshore, 0 AS ord, a.manpower_cr, a.boe, a.regular_headcount
    FROM a JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = a.asset_wc_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'All producing assets', 'all', 1, SUM(manpower_cr), SUM(boe), SUM(regular_headcount) FROM a
)
SELECT
    u.asset,
    u.onshore_offshore,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr, 1) AS manpower_cost_inr_cr,
    ROUND(u.boe / 1e6, 2) AS mmboe_fy26,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr * 1e7 / NULLIF(u.boe, 0), 0) AS manpower_cost_inr_per_boe,
    ROUND(u.manpower_cr * 1e7 / NULLIF(u.boe, 0) / fx.fx, 2) AS manpower_cost_usd_per_boe,
    u.regular_headcount,
    ROUND(u.boe / NULLIF(u.regular_headcount, 0), 0) AS boe_per_employee
FROM u CROSS JOIN fx
ORDER BY u.ord, manpower_cost_usd_per_boe DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: H1
-- Question: List the executives with more than 3 years at their current station (rotation policy), by asset and grade.
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL counted ALL current executives per WC/grade (no tenure test, LIMIT 20). Now: active executives
-- (cadre='executive') whose continuous stay at the current work centre began more than 3 years before 2026-10-19
-- (posting islands, so in-place promotions do not reset station tenure); all WC x grade rows, no LIMIT.
WITH numbered_postings AS (
    SELECT
        p.emp_id, p.wc_id, p.from_date, p.is_current_posting, p.grade_id,
        -- exemption columns hold the literal string 'None' when no exemption exists
        IF(LOWER(IFNULL(p.exemption_tag, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), NULL, p.exemption_tag) AS exemption_tag,
        IF(LOWER(IFNULL(p.exemption_reason_code, 'none')) IN ('none', ''), NULL, p.exemption_reason_code) AS exemption_reason_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.emp_id ORDER BY p.from_date, p.posting_id) -
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.emp_id, p.wc_id ORDER BY p.from_date, p.posting_id) AS island_id
    FROM posting_history p
),
current_station AS (
    -- continuous stay at the current work centre (in-place promotions do not reset station tenure)
    SELECT
        emp_id, wc_id,
        MIN(from_date) AS station_from_date,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, grade_id, NULL)) AS grade_id,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, exemption_tag, NULL)) AS exemption_tag,
        MAX(IF(is_current_posting, exemption_reason_code, NULL)) AS exemption_reason_code
    FROM numbered_postings
    GROUP BY emp_id, wc_id, island_id
    HAVING LOGICAL_OR(is_current_posting)
),
active_execs AS (
    SELECT cs.*, e.age_years, e.discipline_id,
           DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-10-19', cs.station_from_date, MONTH) AS station_tenure_months,
           cs.station_from_date < DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-10-19', INTERVAL 3 YEAR) AS over_3_years
    FROM current_station cs
    JOIN dim_grade g ON g.grade_id = cs.grade_id
    JOIN employee_master e ON e.emp_id = cs.emp_id
    WHERE LOWER(g.cadre) = 'executive'
      AND LOWER(e.employment_status) = 'active'
)
SELECT
    wc.short_name AS work_centre,
    wc.hard_station_cat,
    ae.grade_id,
    COUNT(*) AS executives_over_3y,
    ROUND(AVG(ae.station_tenure_months) / 12, 1) AS avg_station_years,
    COUNTIF(ae.exemption_tag IS NOT NULL) AS with_recorded_exemption,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY wc.short_name) AS work_centre_total_over_3y,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS company_total_over_3y,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_execs) AS company_active_executives
FROM active_execs ae
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON wc.wc_id = ae.wc_id
WHERE ae.over_3_years
GROUP BY wc.short_name, wc.hard_station_cat, ae.grade_id
ORDER BY work_centre_total_over_3y DESC, wc.short_name, executives_over_3y DESC;

-- Answer Key SQL: H3
-- Question: What is the vacancy position (sanctioned vs. in-position) by asset and discipline?
-- Type: data
-- Semantic audit 2026-10-20: old SQL averaged row-level vacancy_rate_pct (unweighted mean of tiny category cells) and
-- truncated at LIMIT 100 ordered alphabetically (591 WC x discipline cells exist), and omitted sanctioned/in-position.
-- Now: FY26 sanctioned, in-position, vacancies and weighted vacancy rate per work centre x discipline, all cells, largest gaps first.
SELECT
    wc.short_name AS work_centre,
    d.name AS discipline,
    SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength) AS sanctioned,
    SUM(sp.in_position_strength) AS in_position,
    SUM(sp.vacancy_count) AS vacancies,
    ROUND(SUM(sp.vacancy_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength), 0), 1) AS vacancy_rate_pct,
    SUM(SUM(sp.sanctioned_strength)) OVER () AS company_sanctioned,
    SUM(SUM(sp.vacancy_count)) OVER () AS company_vacancies
FROM sanctioned_posts sp
JOIN dim_work_centre wc ON sp.wc_id = wc.wc_id
JOIN dim_discipline d ON sp.discipline_id = d.discipline_id
WHERE sp.fiscal_year = @fiscal_year
GROUP BY wc.short_name, d.name
ORDER BY vacancies DESC, vacancy_rate_pct DESC, work_centre, discipline;
